3347b8e81d8880c6bb4afc7c1cd7f69c.description: Unseen Studio (Bristol/London, brand + digital + motion) turned its 2025 year in review into a standalone microsite, Awwwards SOTD and Developer Award winner. The whole thing is a month-by-month scroll narrative: January through December become chapters, each stamped with a monospaced project code (US_01_25), letter-spaced month wordmarks and tags like [motion] [jan_25], mixing autoplaying video R&D loops, client launches (Netflix jobs site, L'Oreal Salon of the Future, BlueYard, Klook, Topology, Kikk Festival, Poly, OceanX) and lab experiments. Black and gold palette, WebGL, parallax, heavy kinetic typography. Excellent reference for studio year-in-review / wrapped formats and timeline-as-narrative scrolling. Note: the automated screenshot captured the branded loader (winged-eye mascot, bracketed [00%] monospace counter) rather than the hero, so the framed visual is the preloader; the loader itself is worth stealing.

2b8b023a2f9046a8bed17153af4e8ca3.description: The saved financial-advisory site is gone. The domain now serves a Chinese-language sports-betting portal: a dense mosaic of high-saturation promo tiles (vivid greens, deep blues, reds and gold) over a light stadium-themed background, heavy bold sans type sized for offer readability, and a live-scores sidebar widget bolted onto the layout. Nothing on the page relates to the original advisory brand, and the domain no longer appears in search under its old identity.

f097ecd24152491c846e0371af0eeb64.description: Portfolio of Abhishek Jha, an award-winning freelance visual designer and developer in New Delhi (Awwwards, CSS Design Awards, Codrops), working across tech, beauty, fashion, food, crypto and SaaS. Editorial technical-minimalist look: a monochromatic arctic palette of icy blues, desaturated greys and off-white grounded by charcoal, with a blocky brutalist custom name lockup against wide-spaced sans metadata. Standout techniques: a heavy global film-grain overlay for analog tactility, HUD/blueprint chrome (thin dividers, crosshairs, boxed metadata) for a drafted architectural feel, and a large soft-edged elliptical mask distorting the hero imagery to break the grid. Notable inner content: a Playbook gallery of type and aesthetic explorations, numbered nav, and a playable Tetris easter egg at /tetris.

0cf399f42620428fadf0ef256699b8bc.description: Instagram's brand page for Instagram Sans, its global custom typeface. Split hero — large text on magenta beside an oversized vector glyph on purple — with the full brand palette (magenta, purple, orange, yellow, black, white) and every word on the page set in Instagram Sans across Regular, Headline, Condensed, Light, Medium and Bold. Three things to steal for any type or brand-guideline page: pink vector paths and anchor points overlaid directly on the letterforms to expose how they were constructed, the 'squircle' narrative that morphs a circle and a square to explain the typeface's signature curvature, and a bento grid mixing Tamil, Japanese and Arabic glyphs to argue global coverage visually rather than in copy. Also shows the font living inside real product UI (stickers, app elements).

36a11a48159b40eaa3fdd0235987ffad.description: Abstract Intelligence is an interactive digital editorial / online exhibit about AI's impact on human creativity, art and culture. Big-type hero built around a provocation ('Artificial Intelligence is already more intelligent than humanity'), set in muted beige with stark black and white and occasional neon-green accents. The typographic mix is the idea to steal: a bold modern grotesk for headlines deliberately paired with pixelated display fonts for navigation and exhibit markers, so the page visually straddles old web and new AI. Structurally it is scroll-driven narrative — floating parallax AI-generated images layered over text at different scroll speeds, case-study sections on real milestones (the Théâtre D'Opéra Spatial prize, the Cosmopolitan AI cover), and ticker-style marquee/timeline elements pinned along the bottom.

29649316e2f141f79893bc380506df62.description: Accordion Productions is an Australian film and photography production collective. The hero sets a classic high-contrast serif ACCORDION in white over a video portrait on a solid mustard-yellow field; navigation is pushed to the corners so the frame stays clean. Deeper sections go avant-garde, with massive black diagonal polygons cutting across stark white negative space. Good reference for single-color brand backdrops and type-over-video composition.

00d95b18537b462c94b09ee3e1d8d671.description: Act+Acre is a plant-based scalp and hair care brand positioning itself as "your trichologist in a box", founded by celebrity stylist and certified trichologist Helen Reavey around a patented Cold Processed technique. Entry is a split-screen lead-gen modal that doubles as audience segmentation: a bold 15% off headline on cream, aspirational faceless hair photography on the right, and concern-based buttons (including GLP-1 hair loss) that route visitors into a personalised funnel — a discount turned into first-party data capture. Warm neutral palette, clean modern sans, editorial product photography. Homepage hero visuals unverified (promo modal blocks the headless render).

2157b8e81d8880178244f08d2d38b8ad.description: Adaline is an observability and evals platform for self-improving AI agents — it turns production traces into behavior maps, auto-generated evals, synthetic data and verified agent improvements. Next.js build. The hero is a short, confident text lede ("Never stop learning") with two CTAs (Get Started / Read Docs) and no hero media in the markup, immediately followed by a very long multi-row scrolling logo marquee (Salesforce, DoorDash, HubSpot, Discord, McKinsey, Superhuman, Reforge, Coframe). Notable blocks: a quote wall mixing text testimonials with YouTube video testimonials (OpenAI, McKinsey, Thrive Capital, Salesforce, Cognition, Greptile), a tabbed four-step process strip (Trace → Behaviors → Evals & Data → Improve) headlined "Ship Once. Improve Forever.", an enterprise trust and compliance block, and a closing CTA over a soft illustrated footer-hills gradient. Visuals unverified (loader/gate in headless render) — the homepage throws a Next.js client-side exception in headless Chromium, so Hero type is left unset.

b7216048d7284fc8b1a982faa9d68343.description: Digital product / development studio site built as a dark, heavily animated experience. The domain resolves and the page responds, but it renders as a full-black canvas in a headless browser across repeated attempts, which points to a WebGL or JS-gated intro sequence. Visuals unverified (loader/gate in headless render) — saved tags describe it as dark, 3D and scrolltelling-driven. Worth revisiting in a real browser before using it as a reference.

b0a51fba0581402388c36a6fb57e2723.description: Æbele Interiors is a high-end interior design studio in Antwerp founded in 2019 by Dutch designer Pieter Æbele Elzenga, covering private residences, real-estate developments, commercial spaces, hotels and yachts, and an authorised retailer for Eric Kuster Metropolitan Luxury and Armani/Casa. Site by Exo Ape and featured on The FWA: muted taupe, stark white and deep charcoal with metallic gold accents, a luxury serif paired with a minimal sans, oversized watermark branding layered behind the content for depth, and a minimal side navigation. Entry is a split-screen product-launch modal with a Visit our Webshop CTA; the Work and Studio pages carry the project case studies.

974f27907fbf4900b882e548f1756dd6.description: Redirected — aerodome.com now 301s to flocksafety.com/products/flock-dfr after Aerodome was acquired by Flock Safety, so the saved URL lands on the Flock DFR product page. The company builds Drone as First Responder systems for police and public-safety agencies: docked drones auto-launch on 911 calls, licence-plate hits or gunshot detection and stream live thermal video to dispatch. Visually it is a full-bleed high-key blue-sky photo hero with a centred extra-bold sans headline and dark forest-green CTAs against beige secondaries, with a drone peeking in from the bottom edge for scale. Worth stealing: the stat band ("86 seconds", "1 in 5 calls", "89% increase") and the three-up spec trio for the Alpha drone.

6c578f9144cc446e8660e2f2fa53dae8.description: AEXLAB is the Miami VR studio behind VAIL VR, a tactical multiplayer shooter with 500k+ players and over $15M raised, launched on Meta Quest in 2024. Aggressive teal-and-black hero: ultra-condensed all-caps mega type over a blurred video backdrop with a lime green CTA. A sci-fi HUD layer decorates the frame with UTC clock, Miami coordinates, thin grid lines and an audio waveform visualizer. Strong reference for gaming-brand HUD chrome and micro-data ornamentation.

e99cf4e1b42c4dfc8484637b6adf10b8.description: Cartier is a Montreal-based creative agency working across advertising, brand identity and media activation. Black and white with a vibrant neon lime accent, dominated by a bold geometric sans. Large-scale typography overlapping video content, minimalist grid, generous white space. Case studies and a video section carry the portfolio. A persistent cookie banner blocks part of the page in headless render, so lower sections are partly visuals unverified.

34e7b8e81d88809687efd58d7fab71e8.description: Social media agency from Montpellier, personality-first branding. Hero: giant blocky type layered behind tilted floating photo cards (3D collage depth), emoji accents, lightning-bolt brand shape and an embedded 'case of the month' UI card; forest green, pink and blue on light. Below: team carousel with per-member audio intros, project sliders, numbered 5-step process, FAQ, 3-step quiz contact form, WhatsApp QR overlay. Strong ref for playful agency sites and human team presentation.

62fa61bfc26f444399b5a790039f334d.description: AI model Inc. (Tokyo, founded Aug 2020) generates AI models, characters and talent for advertising, e-commerce and social: virtual try-on from product-only photography, attribute-based model deployment, chatbots and interactive signage, for adidas, PUMA, Isetan Mitsukoshi, Ito En, SHIPS and Wacoal. The first viewport is a minimal typographic splash on soft off-white with charcoal text, vast negative space and corner-anchored navigation, pairing a high-contrast serif logo-mark (a slash integrated into A/ MODEL) with a clean sans tagline, using a Blade Runner reference (DO AI MODELS DREAM OF ELECTRIC SHEEP?) as an intellectual hook. Below: an oversized numbered section system (00 PREFACE / 01 CAPABILITY / 02 FEATURES / 03 MODELS IN USE), looping CREATE/CUSTOMIZE marquees, an ORIGIN vs MODIFIED garment-swap comparison, a stats block of four 100%-uplift metrics (CTR, revenue, time on site, bounce), and four numbered case studies tagged by deliverable (KEY VISUAL / TV CM / SIGNAGE).

e87d127cada145bea1a01795342d2373.description: Akkers van Margraten is a Dutch memorial project documenting how the American war cemetery at Margraten shaped the surrounding community, told year by year (1944, 1945, 1947, 1948), including the Adopt-A-Grave programme started in 1945. The 1945 chapter uses the year itself as oversized structural type behind the content: deep charcoal ground, cream typography, desaturated sepia and muted-green historical map imagery, a heavy geometric sans for headings paired with a refined serif for narrative body copy. Notable blocks — a circular veteran portrait that triggers video testimony, an inlaid historical map, and a dated event feed running as a vertical scrolling timeline.

c390a57ca7124ca3b1646aa6fee135d9.description: Akuto Studio (Lausanne, 'New Ways of Playing') sells the Chord Machine AKT-0.1, a USB-C MIDI/CV controller built for playing chords intuitively. Hero is brutalist typography-as-architecture: screen-filling bold grotesque 'CHORD MACHINE' in black over a desaturated high-grain stone/concrete photographic texture, with 'AKT-0.1' tucked into the negative space of the E. Palette is strict black and white plus one international orange-red used for every clickable thing, and a circular 'Mailing list' button intentionally breaks the horizontal bands to create depth. Vue-based SPA with a dedicated FAQ inner page.

2e22a9f0e75f403c8df81e7ef84cf017.description: Portfolio site for freelancer Alexis Gardin with a premium dark hero. A navy-to-royal-blue gradient carries subtle grain and vertical light streaks; Malt and Google rating badges sit directly above the H1 for instant social proof, and a sticky bottom 'Parlons de votre projet' bar includes a profile photo for a personal, approachable touch to a high-tech service.

3177b8e81d88805eb7c2d8ba54c3bff0.description: Alfa-Bank is one of Russia's largest private banks (cards, cash loans, mortgages, auto loans, Alfa-Online, business banking). Its homepage is a strong example of a bento-grid hero doing the work of a whole landing page: a dark charcoal base with cards in lavender, sky blue and peach, anchored by the signature brand red, each tile carrying one product promise at a different size so the hierarchy reads instantly. Typography pairs bold tech-leaning headings with a clean digital sans. Worth stealing: the iridescent chrome 3D renders (infinity symbol, objects) dropped into soft pastel tiles - the contrast between matte card and metallic object makes the grid feel tactile instead of flat, and it is a smart way to give a mass-market bank a premium, futuristic edge without abandoning clarity.

12cb700265644d6d8e2019f8f6a82e7c.description: Allbirds is a sustainable DTC footwear and apparel brand using merino wool, eucalyptus fibre and sugarcane. The hero is an asymmetrical split — a full-body lifestyle shot beside a tight product close-up, divided by a vertical typographic band — in an earthy muted palette of olive, oatmeal and slate with a clean modern sans plus a script brand mark. The distinctive move is a layer of hand-drawn white line doodles (a bird, an arrow) sketched over sharp urban photography, a tactile sketchbook overlay that softens the ecommerce grid. Product grids and lifestyle galleries follow below.

0e64d22958994d4c8a777eb679ada0a0.description: Alphamark is a creative branding studio focused on B2B brand transformation — identity design, Webflow development and brand positioning. Black background, white type, vibrant yellow reserved strictly for primary CTAs; oversized sans in mixed bold/light weights carries the hierarchy, and a floating 'Play Reel' element sits in the minimal hero. It is a good template for agency credibility stacking: an 'Our Impact' stats block with large percentages (142% increase, 97% retention), an awards/recognition logos bar (Awwwards, Behance), a numbered services block (1. Brand, 2. Website) with visual previews, a featured-projects gallery with interactive hover states, selected case studies, and large-text client quotes with headshots and Clutch ratings. A persistent 'Transform my brand' sticky CTA follows the scroll in the bottom-right.

1d07b8e81d88808eaf4efde9d84b95f1.description: Alpine is a 30-year-old Dutch hearing-protection brand (earplugs and earmuffs for sleep, concerts, swimming, motorcycling, kids), running on Shopify. The hero is a rotating full-width photo carousel of seasonal campaign banners with the headline set as an SVG lockup, over a bold red and soft mint palette with abstract 3D shapes in the background. The most useful blocks are the icon-led "shop by situation" row (Party, Sleep, Motor, Swim, Kids), a trust bar that turns proof into design (100-day guarantee, 75,000+ 5-star reviews, B Corp, 2x Red Dot), and a bundle-and-save cross-sell module with struck-through pricing. Product cards lead with three benefit bullets and a dB rating instead of a description. Solid reference for a benefit-first e-commerce PDP grid.

3437b8e81d8880d3aa0cc8e6c28c39fd.description: Finnish health-tech startup selling Alveos One, a wearable acoustic respiratory monitor that senses breathing through chest vibrations and coaches nervous-system regulation. Hero is a centered product render melting into a warm taupe-to-cream atmospheric gradient, soft-focus edges and a frosted-glass pill button — calm, symmetric, "zen" hardware branding. Strong trust stack: press logos bar, an evidence section with validation-study stats (94.6% within 2 breaths/min, University of Kent), a day-timeline of state shifts, founder team cards with bios, Kickstarter social proof (204% funded) and FAQ. Good example of science-backed product storytelling for wellness hardware.

3177b8e81d88801b8e58de7ce22f1268.description: AMD Group (About Making a Difference) is a Saudi holding company that builds and runs creative ventures aligned with Vision 2030: Zan (communications agency), LOTF (corporate gifting), MHRF Type (Arabic and Latin typeface studio), RAWA (content) and Each (production house). Bilingual EN/AR. The hero is a split composition in olive and muted sage with an oversized modernist grotesque AMD GROUP wordmark spanning across the vertical divide, a wavy moire line pattern standing in for imagery, and a background video; a preloader cycles the portfolio brand codes (ZAN, LOTF, MHRF, RAWA) as it counts up. Notable blocks: a scroll timeline from 2015 through 2030 mapping each venture to a moment in the national transformation, a Create / Evolve / Succeed kinetic word-stack, an AMD in Number stats row (5+ portfolios, 15 awards, 400+ projects, 300+ clients, 50+ renewed contracts), and a five-slide portfolio carousel with per-brand logos and copy. Good reference for holding-company architecture and Arabic-market premium branding.

1f795f2480e04981b493c1ec5ed4210c.description: Amie is a calendar/productivity app. The hero pairs a bold sans headline with a hand-drawn yellow highlighter marking the USP and a high-fidelity product UI screenshot placed directly below, showing structured timelines and AI summaries before the user scrolls. Clean white and light-grey palette with a vibrant blue CTA; the highlighter and immediate product context are the strong, steal-worthy moves.

3687b8e81d8880a7b699ffaa243d4c50.description: Clinical AI agents platform for healthcare. Split hero: bold serif headline with terracotta accents on warm off-white, product video with an embedded clinician-agent-patient workflow diagram and a scrolling services list overlaid on the media. Below: large customer logo marquee, stats trio (3M+, 10x, 34x), testimonial cards with case-study links, specialty ticker, numbered tabbed process sections (01-03 Digital Residency, Define-Train-Deploy-Optimize), EHR integration logo wall. Strong ref for healthcare SaaS that needs trust-heavy storytelling.

c64dc3b25d154af486483dc34749338d.description: Amity (known for its social.plus chat, feeds and community SDKs) now positions around AI-powered customer experience and AI agents. The hero is centred and typography-first: large bold white sans on a near-black charcoal ground, with an atmospheric starry-particle texture and a soft radial glow lightening the centre to focus the message, rounded info cards along the bottom edge and a pill CTA with arrow icon. Clean dark futuristic-infrastructure aesthetic — the particle-field background and monochrome restraint are the techniques to borrow.

16c7b8e81d88804ca2d2eb8c1f27fa4e.description: Amplemarket is an AI sales platform (lead generation, multichannel outreach, deliverability, a "Duo" copilot reading intent signals) for B2B revenue teams. The hero is restrained and premium: a soft off-white canvas, a high-contrast editorial serif headline against clean sans UI, and a single rounded pill block that fuses the email field, the CTA button and social proof (G2 stars, Gartner badge) into one conversion unit — the neatest detail on the page and easy to reuse. A partial product-UI reveal peeks above the fold to pull the scroll. Below: a logo bar, an animated signal/copilot showcase, a four-pillar platform section, metric-led customer stories (78% open rate, 9x ROI) and a large "Wall of Love" testimonial grid.

3a12bf7a6406456ea88d987f3456a2ab.description: Amuse-Bouche is a Portuguese gastronomy brand built around food experiences and shared dining. The entry is a kinetic typographic showreel rather than a static hero: rapid staccato cuts and sliding panel wipes reveal the statement line piece by piece, in inky black-and-white with heavy film grain and textured imagery. Type is a bold high-contrast modern serif (Ogg/Canela family feel) set at huge scale and used as a structural element that frames and masks the visuals underneath. Techniques worth stealing: type-as-mask, rhythmic cut timing to create urgency, and analog grain overlays to keep an all-digital build from feeling sterile. Strong reference for scrolltelling food and hospitality sites that want an editorial-film mood.

b03eacba13f84cf2b0b9eda6f14d1392.description: Webflow-built annual report microsite for the Amway One by One Foundation (2021 charity/impact report). The hero is pure big-type editorial: oversized geometric sans headlines bleeding toward the edges, with a continuous hand-drawn electric-blue stroke weaving through and behind the letterforms, plus a rough handwritten script tagline for contrast. Palette is stark white and black with one vivid blue accent. Useful reference for turning a dry annual report into a scrollable story, and for mixing rigid display type with organic analog marks.

16d7b8e81d8880e49f66c55bb773d78b.description: ANAI (Anai Wood Factory, est. 1964) is a small Japanese sawmill in Minamioguni, Kumamoto, selling structural and interior building materials made from local Oguni cedar and cypress, with its own consumer brands (FIL lifestyle goods, the Take no Kuma café). Hero is radical whitespace plus an elegant high-contrast serif line, "Cultivate for Posterity", with the misty forest photograph placed below the headline rather than behind it, which gives the page a gallery-like vertical rhythm instead of the default hero-image cliche. Near-monochrome black and white grounded by desaturated forest greens. Notable inner blocks: an architectural project slider (Higo Bank, Kyushu University OIP, private houses) and a dedicated Oguni-Sugi material story page. Beautiful reference for craft, material and heritage brands.

759e23a96ef843d4b0b7bc2b222f1ad5.description: Antara Studio, a design studio site. The domain resolves and serves a light neutral canvas, but content never paints in a headless browser across repeated attempts with long waits, which suggests a JS-driven intro or scroll-triggered reveal. Visuals unverified (loader/gate in headless render). Saved tags point to a light, gradient, big-type serif layout on a grid.

2157b8e81d888067849bd548d6585195.description: Antimetal (NYC) is an "autonomous system for production" — a world model plus an army of agents that diagnose, fix and prevent infrastructure issues on top of Datadog, Grafana, Kubernetes and AWS. The hero is text-led and confident: a short declarative headline ("Production that runs itself.") with a subhead and two CTAs, immediately followed by a 2:07 video testimonial card from Google's VP of Engineering. Distinctive blocks include a diagrammatic "representational gap" chart plotting system complexity against what humans can hold in their heads, a three-tier stack diagram (Your Team → Antimetal Agents → World Model → Production) ringed by an integration logo cluster with "+92 more", a named agent roster (Patrol, Triage, World Model, Agent Builder), an embedded live demo iframe, and a research-log blog feed. Visuals unverified (loader/gate in headless render) — headless renders return a Vercel error page, so the description is HTML-derived.

ebb1f84e5db34bc2b21552b6ecb790bf.description: Apeel Sciences makes plant-derived coatings that extend produce shelf life and cut food waste. Off-white ground with deep forest green for text and buttons, and heavy bold sans headings. Aerial orchard photo hero. Steal-worthy: high-contrast macro photography of fruit used as literal proof the product works, and a "sticker" style logos bar that folds press mentions into the layout instead of parking them in the usual grey strip. The FAQ block is framed as "let's talk about the noise", answering objections head-on.

3be1569b6e864a03bfdd89d6cd421914.description: Arcadia is an enterprise energy intelligence platform — one place to pay utility bills, buy energy and report on sustainability (recently acquired by ENGIE Impact, announced in a top banner). The hero is restrained eco-tech: deep forest green, neutral slate and off-white, with a large light-weight geometric sans headline carrying the value proposition on its own. The detail worth stealing is the rounded card-within-a-page container holding the hero content, which adds depth without ornament, plus a high-contrast announcement bar that keeps corporate news from competing with the brand message. Below: a 'Trusted by' logos bar (Ford, Oracle, Intuit, Penske, Conagra) and three-tier feature cards.

de5f38debf0a4095acdde1c17c2c03f7.description: Arrow Dynamics is a paid Framer code-component library built on p5.js, adding interactive pointer-driven animations and patterns across 15 named variations (Accelerators, Gravitators, Oscillators, Resonators and more), each a physics behaviour around the cursor. The hero is advanced skeuomorphism: a matte-black heavily grained hardware panel with recessed knobs, a warm glowing gauge and lime-green voltage-style readouts, framing a screen-within-a-screen value prop — a strong reference for tactile, device-like UI. Typography pairs a high-contrast ligatured serif wordmark against all-caps mono labels for a luxury-engineering feel. Notable blocks: a variations gallery with live demos, a two-tier pricing block where the Pro tier sells the Framer and Figma files of this very site, and a user manual/FAQ.

08bf095769274163a1232bfc770fc507.description: Portfolio of Artemii Lebedev, art director, designer and developer (founder of Le:mma Studio), based in Belgrade and New York. Hero is a photorealistic 3D scene — a laptop on textured concrete with real light falloff and floor reflections — on near-black (#0A0A0A) with white all-caps monospace type and a single royal-blue accent from the screen. Distinctive: an information-dense border layout pinning metadata (live CEST clock, location, ongoing-project count) to the viewport edges while the centre stays clear, inverted white-bar hover states on the work list, and a 'press ESC for effects' easter egg. Strong inner pages: /work, /archive, /alter-ego, plus a Codrops-linked journal feed.

6f3bcbc055df487b835791c492b60694.description: Arthur is an AI governance / observability control plane ("AI governance for everyone") pitched at security, finance and the teams shipping AI. Note the site has been redesigned since the tags on this record: it is now a dark-mode big-type hero on deep plum/black, with tight-tracked geometric sans, neon lime CTAs and a mint announcement bar ("Best Practices for Building Agents Recap") stacked above the nav. Minimal illustrative elements only at the bottom. Worth stealing: the announcement-bar-as-secondary-value pattern, and neon-on-plum colour blocking that keeps a governance product from looking corporate-dull. Platform, Pricing and Developers are the substantive inner pages.

b416e4f278e0476f9738456c7cda2b61.description: Asana is a work-management platform now leading with AI teammates for human-agent teams. The hero is a centred value proposition plus lead-capture form on a clean white ground, with high-contrast black type, a vibrant pink-to-purple gradient highlighting the key phrase and the coral-red logo adding warmth. The standout technique is a floating video-based conversational AI widget overlaying the right side of the hero — an interactive demo living inside the first viewport rather than below the fold. Bold tight-tracked sans headlines with clear weight-based hierarchy.

52556e70cbb24f3c8226280dd073f504.description: Ask Phill is a Shopify Plus Platinum Partner agency running large-scale e-commerce migrations, strategy, design and development for European fashion, lifestyle and beauty brands. The hero is a photo-led stack of lifestyle/fashion imagery rather than the usual agency big-type opener, set in a high-contrast palette of black, cream and bright red with oversized bold sans headings. Best blocks to steal: a dynamic case-study card stack where portfolio items overlap and animate as layered cards, an animated stats block (chart plus counter) used as proof, a client logos bar, and a team headshot grid. Section-to-section background colour transitions (black into cream) give the scroll a deliberate rhythm.

2887b8e81d8880acab06fd974e0c4cc6.description: Assurestor is a UK channel-only vendor of cloud backup and disaster-recovery platforms (Backup2Cloud on Asigra, DR2Cloud on Zerto, SaaS2Cloud, Veeam2Cloud, plus an NG line on HYCU), sold exclusively through MSPs and resellers. Structurally it is a clean partner-led B2B layout: a four-platform feature card set, a numbered 1-2-3 "why us" strip, a partner-quote carousel, and a compliance trust row of ISO 9001/14001/22301/27001 and Cyber Essentials badges used the way most sites use client logos. Visuals unverified (the Next.js app throws a client-side exception in headless render), so hero type is left unset.

1c68ff45cdec43b6be4d87fe33d2f619.description: At-Home Club is an arts and culture project built on a rigid editorial grid. The hero anchors the corners with high-contrast serif titles, condensed sans and vertical text, then runs narrow vertical image strips inside a thin-lined grid for a magazine-like, dense-information hierarchy. Neutral gray and black base with a sharp red accent for emphasis.

33a25e26d64c4dfda8de5c98ca6dfef4.description: "A Promise Broken" is a long-form research essay from L'Atelier, BNP Paribas' foresight arm, on how social mobility broke down in the digital age — subtitled "How the average person plays The Game of Life with loaded dice". It is one chapter of a larger chaptered report hub (/social-mobility) that also covers the virtual economy and economic opportunity for avatars, so the whole series is worth studying as a model for editorial research microsites with scroll-driven chapters and a strong data-backed argument. Visuals unverified — a OneTrust cookie wall blocks the headless render, including on retry with an accept click.

1d07b8e81d8880499ec3c5155de90d5d.description: Atoll Digital is a Montreal web design agency positioning itself for ambitious B2B brands (WordPress, corporate, franchise and manufacturing sites, projects from ~$35K). The hero is pure big type: a heavy custom geometric sans headline anchored low-left against deep obsidian navy and off-white, balanced by a single hairline rule, with a scroll cue and an "in business since ©2016" marker used as a typographic detail. Editorial-style case studies (Kubota, Spafax, RD Legal, Ether Capital) each get their own full-width slab with an industry label, and a numeric "11 added portfolio projects" counter doubles as a vault teaser. Also has a four-icon Design/Code/Engage/Expand expertise grid. Strong reference for restrained, typography-led agency positioning.

d10004323d164b3da9edee31e808c8e8.description: Atoms is the habit-building app from James Clear, built on the Atomic Habits framework. The design is deliberately editorial rather than SaaS: cream and off-white backgrounds cut with high-contrast black sections, a high-contrast serif for headlines against a clean sans for body, and muted sage and mustard accents inside the illustrations. Hero is a product shot — an iPhone mockup sitting alongside large serif type. Strongest blocks: the Four Laws feature section (obvious, attractive, easy, satisfying) which turns book content into a design system, a Process block ('we meet you where you are', 'we evolve as you evolve'), phone mockups showing identity-based habits and notifications, a card-based Daily Lessons gallery, and a closing CTA anchored by the physical book cover plus app store links. Abstract organic line art is used to visualise psychological concepts without stock-illustration cliche.

2b814fe4ba1c42a080d973f3cafd9d32.description: Atomus is a paid Figma design system ($99/$199 one-time, sold via Gumroad) made by Buenos Aires agency stan+vision, aimed at professional design studios. Monochrome black/white/grey base punched with primary red, yellow and blue; bold sans headline with a high-contrast serif accent on one word; PP Neue Montreal and PP Neue World from Pangram Pangram. Two strong steal-worthy blocks: a draggable physics playground of loose buttons, toggles and tooltips you can throw around ("unrelated but totally fun"), and a live virtual editor that lets you flip dark theme, swap three colour palettes and switch typeface on a fake app UI — selling a design system by letting you operate one instead of screenshotting it. Meta-UI touches (Figma sidebar chrome, collaborative cursors) signal the audience instantly. Copy is deliberately profane and irreverent. Site by stan+vision, built in Webflow.

3f64de89912649b7bca451ed62fde3f2.description: Studio-hosted build of the website for Atria, a proactive preventative-healthcare company with luxury clinics in NYC and Palm Beach, deliberately blurring healthcare and hospitality to feel warm and human rather than clinical. Site by Non-Linear Studio (Park City / New York / Tallinn), whose case study at non-linear.studio/work/atria covers information architecture, art direction, 3D/motion, design and development, and cites a 'healthcare by the numbers' stats treatment plus heavy photography art direction; the work won w3 Best in Show for Use of Video or Motion Graphics and Gold for Health Care Services. The client-facing production site now lives at atria.org. Visuals unverified (loader/gate in headless render) — the domain serves a styled cream page but scroll-driven content never painted across two attempts, so the structure noted here is drawn from the studio's case study rather than the live subdomain.

34e7b8e81d8880cd994bebf115beef0d.description: Premium Canadian vodka brand, site by Locomotive (Montreal). Big-type hero 'Born From The Untouched Wilderness' with italic serif accents and a 2min film link; cinematic nature storytelling (glacier water, aurora), bottle anatomy chapters, product cards for vodka / seltzers / mocktails with expandable spec sheets on gradient backdrops. Editorial age gate: grain-textured card framed by flared serif wordmarks on charcoal, itself a strong ref for branded gates. Screenshot currently shows the age gate.

805ebc953eb84212a10d092c79bfa4aa.description: AuthKit by WorkOS is a fully-featured UI component system for authentication flows, built on Radix. The hero is a dense dark technical scene: midnight-navy near-black with a top-down spotlight beam falling from the logo, an icy pale-blue extra-bold headline with a subtle outer glow, a blueprint grid overlay with X-markers and corner dots, starfield noise, and semi-transparent glassmorphic login cards floating below — a strong reference for developer-tool atmosphere. Standout blocks: a live login-box customizer (colour, radius, logo, appearance), a Radix design-system section, an animated security showcase covering leaked-password protection, RBAC, bot detection and MFA, and a platform diagram.

0084bd5071d4433d8954b0b856faa080.description: Dedicated microsite for Avantt, a functionalist architecture-inspired sans-serif (8 weights plus italics) by Martin Vácha for Displaay Type Foundry (FWA and CSSDA). The hero is a vertical split screen — a vibrant magenta action sidebar (Trial/Buy/Test pills), a muted olive-grey centre with big overlapping circles calling out '8 Weights', and a charcoal panel of foundry history overlaid with oversized semi-transparent lettering. Reference for bold split-column type-specimen microsites.

8018aa4d936540f79e0d9fe70ff3217f.description: AVVR (De Advocaten van Van Riet) is a Dutch law and notary firm in Utrecht specialising in real estate and corporate law. The hero is pure big type on a deep forest-green field: a bold sans headline that switches mid-sentence into a serif italic for the emphasised word, which is a cheap and very effective way to build hierarchy inside a single line. Coral-red is used sparingly as the only accent, most notably in the circular arrow paired with a grey pill CTA. Subtle abstract linework sits in the background and a photo peeks in at the bottom edge, grounding an otherwise typographic page. Useful reference for premium professional-services branding that avoids the usual corporate-blue trap.

c65eb249816d4cc99ade86c4423f57df.description: Awsmd is a data-driven UX/UI and development agency in San Francisco (Intel, Uber, Oracle, GoFundMe, New Balance, State Farm). The hero pairs a soft lavender/lilac gradient with a weight-contrasted headline — light 'We create' above extra-bold, slightly skewed 'Awesome Design' with a typing caret — while a vibrant purple 3D cable and USB connector weave in front of and behind the type for real depth. A floating glassmorphic pill nav, a circular-path 'click to play' label and an embedded Clutch 4.9 gold-verified badge sit inside the hero itself. Strongest block is a stats set where each number (+300 projects, 100K reviews, +10 years, +280 team) is paired with its own looping video object; also a dual logo marquee, portfolio video grid and client testimonials.

17b7b8e81d8880889ebfd78727db11bd.description: AYOCIN (Amsterdam) sells ATMOS, a €2,990 sculptural floor lamp that combines HEPA air purification, full-spectrum daylight and red-light therapy, positioned as an interior art piece rather than a gadget. Website by Obys, and it shows: a heavily art-directed scrolltelling build with a scroll-progress counter, the product name set as a massive background wordmark that works as texture, warm walnut/copper/amber earth tones and soft leaf shadows for an at-home feel. Best blocks are the numbered chapter sections (Air purification, Get the Sun Inside, Healing Powers of Red Light), a drag-to-toggle interaction where you pull across the lamp to switch the light on and off, a material/finish selector across three editions, a dimension callout, and an accordion FAQ. Reference-grade premium hardware storytelling.

1a91e08bf61146b693d472b9c7fd15b9.description: Landing page for Begg, a liquid egg product sold in milk-carton-style packaging for bakery, HoReCa and confectionery use. Off-white, orange-yellow and black palette mixing heavy condensed sans with a loose brush script; the hero pairs oversized type with a 3D product render and dissolves into the next section through a fluid liquid-splash mask transition. Notable blocks: a nutrition/energy-value section where vitamin and mineral capsules float as an animated cloud at varying speeds, a usage section where large letterforms are image-masked with food textures, a scroll-triggered chicken illustration that flies across the storage/logistics block, and an accordion of product benefits against a split orange colour block. Good reference for making food-industry spec data feel playful.

34d595742e5740a2ad3a20a0372d2b1a.description: The Badass Project (Ion & Jone, Bergara, Basque Country) is a documentary photography and film studio — 'Real life. No rules.' The hero is a photo-driven 2x2 grid where full-bleed images act as primary navigation (Commercial, Wedding, Family, Personal), under a high-visibility yellow header with an edgy custom logo and bold serif category labels. Reference for immersive image-grid navigation and punchy yellow-on-black photo branding.

a1af9b5b3ef7441c8204dfdbdae0b390.description: Banky, a consumer fintech / banking product. The hero is high-energy big type on sunshine yellow with electric blue accents and black text, hierarchy driven by scale and colour shifts on the branded verb. The signature idea is the dictionary-entry aesthetic: the brand name is presented with phonetics, verb forms and an example sentence, which turns positioning copy into a memorable visual device. A thick angled white path cuts through the composition for movement, an intentionally oversized pill button carries the main CTA, and floating product cards peek in at the bottom for context.

66606dad64664319a28143bfb8100153.description: Barge 166 is Maison Ferrand's floating spirits cellar, a restored 1948 Freycinet barge moored on the Seine where private cognac and rum casks are aged. Entry is through an age gate that is itself a design piece: dark charcoal with gold outlined serif display type, a scalloped decorative border, faint radial background lines and a 'Floating Cellar' seal. Behind it the landing is a deliberately sparse dark splash, silver circular logo centred, lone burgundy MENU button pushed to the corner. The story is structured as numbered chapters (Part I–IV) rather than marketing sections, with a heavy gallery and a two-person team block. Site by Viens-la.

d5d22796d20d4d1c8dcaf82fdb027f99.description: Base is a branding and design agency positioning around "Transforming brands for growth". Hero is built on one idea executed well: a large-scale black-and-white typographic statement, "CHANGE IS IN OUR NATURE", where a neon green line-art icon slot rapidly cycles through symbols (cube, diamond, smiley, tree, globe, heart) to literally animate the breadth of their work. Below it a split two-column band of micro-text grounds the headline, and the bottom of the hero carries a heavily blurred slow video in beige and green for organic depth without distraction. Minimal spaced-out nav with a pill Contact button.

16c7b8e81d8880e98bbdcddb3933f1df.description: Base Habitation is a Quebec prefab housing company selling two compact modular cabin models built on a carbon-negative wood-fibre-and-hemp panel system, sold as a complete build system with a certified builder and a fixed price. The hero is a full-bleed atmospheric photo of a mountain lakeside with a bold bottom-weighted white headline ("Dream big, live simple."), letting the landscape breathe before any copy lands; a single international-orange logo mark is the only saturated colour against natural greens, greys and muted blues. Notable blocks: before/after image comparison sliders used repeatedly (Summer/Winter, Stripped down/Full kitchen, Loft/Bedroom), rotating elevation renders of each model, a values grid with line-drawn icons, a partner logo strip, a deep FAQ on airtightness and thermal lag, and a founder bio. Site by MILL3 (mill3.studio); FR/EN bilingual.

8606ad850bdd4e229fa5aad594ffaefb.description: Baton is a logistics / trucking-tech company ("On the road to change") positioning itself around driver quality of life and transfer-hub freight. The hero is wide-angle drone photography of a highway cutting through green farmland, used as a leading line for momentum, with an ultra-heavy blocky BATON wordmark bleeding off the bottom edge of the frame. Palette: earthy greens and asphalt grey against a high-saturation orange brand accent; clean sans nav with small colour-coded square bullets. Worth stealing: the logo-bleed crop as a compositional anchor, and colour-coded nav bullets as a low-cost wayfinding cue. Strong Purpose and Stories inner pages.

4aa92f8ee9a040468b2c5e995f2c1ff6.description: BAVET is a Belgian spaghetti restaurant chain with a deliberately loud, fun brand. Visuals unverified — a promotional modal blocks the fold on every headless render, including a retry with a dismiss click, so the real hero was never reached and hero type and blocks are left unset. What the modal does show: a split layout pairing candid, joyful photography of families against a neutral off-white ground with bold condensed sans headlines and red brand accents, targeting families with specific child-friendly hooks. Worth opening in a real browser to capture the actual hero.

c677cbff4e9446889ac7c55237831003.description: Beans Agency, a creative digital studio. The hero is a full 3D scene: whimsical bean-shaped characters staged inside a detailed surreal office, rendered in a fully monochromatic yellow world with dark navy reserved for type and UI. Bold geometric sans headline with tight leading. The standout move is brand literalism, personifying the studio name as 3D characters, plus monochrome texturing that reads plastic, fuzz and matte all in one hue, and soft cinematic lighting that keeps the yellow from going flat. Strong reference for playful 3D branding without colour clutter.

3177b8e81d888020836cf4c78d719015.description: Belle Duffner is a US product and brand designer (Netflix, CBS Sports, Deloitte) whose Framer portfolio leads with personality rather than case-study density. The hero is a warm cream page framed by loose hand-drawn charcoal doodles in muted burnt orange, sky blue and moss green, including a sketch of the designer and her pet, with a high-contrast serif greeting (Hello! I'm Belle) and a Let's chat CTA; the illustrations act as a border that funnels the eye inward. Notable blocks: a work grid where each card leads with the outcome rather than the client (Building collegiate golfers' futures, Providing peace to families in public spaces), a booked-until availability badge, a Craft/playground gallery of side projects (artwork, Arduino), and a skills word cluster. Good reference for personal-brand warmth, hand-drawn UI accents and outcome-first project naming.

8dade47f37b8400fb26047f05e2000c7.description: Portfolio for Benjamin Righetti, Swiss concert organist, composer and professor at HEMU Lausanne, organist at St-François and founder of Organopole. The Netlify build is the designed version worth studying: Swiss minimalism in strict black and white, an oversized tightly-kerned neo-grotesque name filling the viewport as the only visual element, and a small low-key colour-graded portrait tucked bottom-right as the humanising anchor, with discreet Menu and Scroll cues. The .com hosts the fuller content — bio, media, discography on Claves Records, and a "pulsometer" section.

7b37c2897faf4a77ade50e7e177f4cbd.description: Bequant is a Madrid network-optimization software company whose BQN platform does TCP optimization, bandwidth shaping and analytics for 600+ ISPs. The hero pairs a massive airy sans headline with an abstract 3D field of glowing orange light streaks on deep black that reads as data flow and network speed, with glassmorphic nav and cards floating over it and subtle outer glows on the type. Two ideas worth stealing: a symbolic background that argues the product's core claim instead of decorating, and a latest-news feed embedded directly in the hero for utility and social proof. Below: numbered feature tiers, a stats row (5M subscribers, 600+ networks), CTO testimonials, an InfoWest case study, a looping logos bar and FAQ.

e42d5f0259c54da4bdf14b76fab62719.description: Cantine Bertani is a Valpolicella producer since 1857 (Amarone Classico, Soave, Secco-Bertani), now part of Angelini Wines & Estates. The homepage opens on a full-bleed macro vineyard image in deep grape-purple and earthy brown with a stark white sans headline, a thin vertical rule carrying rotated brand lettering, and a delicate serif "since 1857" tagline — a magazine-style sidebar treatment worth borrowing. Navigation is stripped back to a hamburger plus a single scroll arrow. The strongest inner page is /about-us, which carries a century-spanning interactive timeline with per-decade imagery. WordPress with a branded SVG preloader; site by Studio Idee Materia.

0c881096a59d48b4b0288a4355697bf1.description: Be The Buzz is a full-funnel GTM marketing agency for B2B SaaS, e-commerce and cybersecurity brands (demand gen, SEO, paid media, RevOps). Dark mesh-gradient hero in deep purple, magenta and amber; an elegant high-contrast serif headline collides with a massive condensed sans SCALE for structural weight. Down the page: white geometric line-art patterns over the gradient, rounded white bento-grid cards for services and a bold purple CTA bar. Good reference for gradient-plus-type energy without imagery.

34e7b8e81d888058bfd1dfb83cc5fba8.description: Better Mistakes is a brand design and Webflow/Framer development agency for B2B tech startups and design studios (140+ projects; clients include Glean, DeepJudge, Proximity Media). Dark hero with massive tight-set sans headline whose words cycle ("crafting digital/scalable/better experiences"), a floating pill navigation, and generously rounded project cards with vivid gradient thumbnails acting as immediate social proof. Trusted-by logo wall, selected-work grid, four service pillars, testimonial quotes and an insights/blog feed (Cannes Lions and Oscar-related client stories). Clean reference for a dev-partner agency site that sells through work, not decoration.

c3cebeb70032444f8d2c00b39318cf9c.description: Better Off Studio is a subscription design studio (tagline Add-to-cart creative) selling UI/UX, brand strategy and content on flat plans with 2-3 day turnaround. Cream off-white site with charcoal type and earthy product photography; ultra-bold cropped display type works as a structural layout element, with product mockups embedded inside and overlapping the oversized letterforms. Asymmetric split hero and generous whitespace keep it premium despite the productized-service pitch; pricing and work sit on dedicated pages.

2887b8e81d88808daee4ddf3314e01d7.description: Bima is not a real company site but a Framer template demo for AI-automation agencies, sold by VeloxThemes, so the live URL carries a "Buy Template" bar. Asymmetric split hero: heavy left-aligned type against a large refractive 3D glass object on the right, on a dark-mode charcoal base with lavender/violet and amber gradient accents. Geometric sans headline with a gradient-filled word ("Machine."), glassmorphic secondary CTAs, luminous background blooms, and an animated webm hero asset. Useful as a reference for the current dark AI-agency landing formula: testimonial ticker directly under the CTA, numbered tech-stack carousel, pricing and team sections stacked in a familiar order.

9412564cfe7841099d4ff6ed6dbd9ab2.description: Bio Sites (by Squarespace) is a link-in-bio builder. The hero is a layered, tilted collage of mobile UI mockups over a warm terracotta and orange field, with a visually dense top half and an airy white lower half that focuses purely on a black pill CTA. The isometric mockup tiling creates depth and energy while showcasing template versatility.

2fc7b8e81d8880fbadcdfaf841af13f4.description: Biograph is a premium preventive-health and longevity clinic (NYC and SF): 30+ advanced diagnostics in a single six-hour visit, a private suite, a physician-led risk profile review, and memberships at $7,500 (Core) and $15,000 (Black), no insurance accepted. The design sells exclusivity through light: a dark obsidian hero built on architectural chiaroscuro, with warm amber glow spilling out of the clinic interior so the building reads as a beacon, vast atmospheric negative space, and the logo etched into the glass so brand and physical space merge. Typography is a clean geometric sans in sentence case, which keeps a $15k product feeling human rather than clinical. Notable blocks: the one-day evaluation walkthrough, tiered membership pricing presented as access rather than cost, and an FAQ that handles the "this doesn't replace your PCP" objection directly.

7738c9bafd7f4889aa6608fb4018f4bc.description: Bison is a design/dev studio with a bold, editorial hero. Maximalist, edge-to-edge ultra-condensed display type is the primary visual anchor instead of imagery, over a dark textured charcoal background with a subtle film-grain overlay for a tactile, physical feel. Aggressive brick-red-on-black color blocking stays legible, and small navigation and metadata frame the giant type for a balanced, professional hierarchy.

30838c4b0b07421cbcf50a80c4737e90.description: Blizzard Entertainment's brand and game portal (Warcraft, Diablo, StarCraft, Overwatch). The hero is a split composition: high-fidelity 3D character renders layered over painterly atmospheric backgrounds in deep indigo and charcoal, lifted by solar orange, gold and electric blue accents, with a bold geometric sans holding legibility against busy artwork. Worth stealing: the subtle glow halo around featured assets that guides the eye without extra UI, and the dual CTA pattern — one saturated brand-blue primary, one muted grey secondary — which sets priority without competing with the art. Below the hero the page becomes a flat tiled grid of game cards and news. Reliable reference for dark, art-first product portals.

7ba6ce4a405e4a498d612934aa7c5ff1.description: The Sea We Breathe is Blue Marine Foundation's award-winning interactive scrollytelling web experience (narrated by Stephen Fry, Webby-winning, translated into eight languages) guiding visitors through marine ecosystems to drive ocean conservation. The headless render only reached an intro state: a deep navy monochrome void with corner-anchored UI — a small all-caps 'EN' language selector top-right and thin geometric line icons bottom-left and right — maximising the central empty space, consistent with a WebGL experience still initialising. Structure includes themed Journey chapters (Marine Protected Areas, Blue Carbon Habitats, Sustainable Fisheries) with long-form conservation copy and goal lists, plus About and partner pages and a companion VR edition. Visuals unverified (loader/gate in headless render) — hero type left unset rather than guessed.

2f61c19bea014a4fa885adf8a73d9e93.description: BlueReceipt is an SMS and text-marketing automation tool for Shopify and ecommerce brands. The hero is a classic split: left-aligned copy and CTAs against a layered product-UI mockup on the right showing an automation-builder dashboard next to a floating mobile message preview. Palette is a white base with vibrant brand blue and dark navy text; typography is a geometric sans with a heavy headline weight. Distinctive touches are the faint icon-pattern background texture and soft drop shadows that make the stacked UI cards feel like they float. Thin below the fold — mainly worth keeping for the hero composition.

42492771538048669522e58e27b6e41a.description: Bolt is a one-click checkout platform for online retailers, sold on conversion lift. Note the site has been redesigned since it was saved — it is now photo-led and dark, not the bright illustrated look in the saved tags. The hero splits the frame with a diagonal jagged edge that mirrors the brand's lightning-bolt mark, which is the single most stealable idea here: using the logo geometry as the layout mask. Palette is deep navy with purple gradients and electric blue; the headline is ultra-heavy sans. An isolated floating checkout UI gives concrete product proof while aspirational photography of a stylish subject keeps it lifestyle rather than software. Good reference for payments and commerce brands moving upmarket.

51d4bd853b334783a7c7edb7c6d1fa94.description: The Books of Design is designstripe's editorial content series on artists and movements that shaped design; this first instalment profiles Alphonse Mucha, framed as 'Art nouveau's reluctant poster boy', with Mucha's style reinterpreted by designstripe illustrator Nico Tiotuico. Structured as seven numbered chapters — Known for, Biography, Crafts, Chronology, Perception, Influences — mixing archival plates (Zodiac 1896, the Job cigarette poster) with pull-quotes used as section headers. Steal-worthy patterns: the Chronology chapter told as a single dated origin story, a Perception chapter built entirely from quotes about the subject, and a before/after Influences list; a separate /gallery inner page holds the artwork. Visuals unverified (headless capture failed repeatedly).

2325edf1af17419884f2c2cdf2f73f5c.description: Boost sells full-stack infrastructure — compliance, capital and technology — that lets insurtechs and MGAs launch digital insurance products. The hero is big geometric sans with tight kerning on deep teal, with the key word underlined by a sharp multi-colour gradient (neon lime to cyan to yellow) that carries the accent palette on its own. The product mockup uses soft neumorphic and glassmorphic layers so it appears to glow against the dark backdrop rather than sit on it. Good reference for embedded-finance and B2B infrastructure sites that need to look technical and premium without going full dark-mode-generic.

71ac0d0ff2a6485e8d866e27a03726aa.description: Bownds Ranches is a fifth-generation Texas ranch brokerage (est. 1885, Utopia TX) marketing and selling ranches, farms, hunting and live-water properties. The hero layers a massive burnt-orange condensed logotype into a full-bleed atmospheric photo of a rider on horseback, sandwiched behind foreground elements for a parallax depth effect, with navigation pushed into the extreme corners. Distinctive blocks: an arrow-glyph marquee cycling property categories (Live Water, Ranches, Farms, Hunting, Recreation), a heritage 'five generations' story block with map-texture overlays, LandReport award badges, and a listing gallery with acreage and price. Heritage western palette of burnt orange, tan, charcoal and sage; flat vector type contrasted against tactile leather and rope textures.

1fc533097026419594b94b3f066eee6a.description: Baunfire agency demo/showcase microsite (Summer '22), not indexed by search. A purely typographic landing page: oversized white headline type fills a saturated monochromatic vermilion field, with neon yellow accents and navigation tucked into the corners so nothing competes with the message. Uses the same lofi-hifi type trick as Baunfire's other work, a slick geometric sans juxtaposed against a crunchy pixelated display font for Summer '22. A strong reference for photography-free heroes carried entirely by scale and a single loud brand colour. Site by Baunfire.

677ae8146e15459e99b98d424833d45f.description: BrainBox AI (now a Trane Technologies company) is an AI building-management platform that autonomously optimises commercial HVAC — three products: ARIA (an AI building engineer for facility managers), AI Control, and a Cloud Building Management System. The hero is built on sharp diagonal architectural geometry over a muted teal-grey and off-white base, with corporate red reserved for branding and primary CTAs and a light-weight sans headline that keeps it minimal rather than heavy; a vertical “Let’s talk” tab is anchored to the right margin, and subtle wavy wireframe patterns bridge the hero into the body. Notable blocks: an animated count-up impact stats set (cities impacted, sq ft managed, buildings optimised) plus a second AI-metrics stat row, a rotating featured-news carousel, three product cards each with a Watch Video hook, a client logos bar (Nordstrom, Dollar Tree, Tractor Supply), a named testimonial set and a case-study grid tagged by building type.

24c0fb7bb2a24e45981b320d95cda795.description: DocuSign's public brand guidelines site — the captured section is 'Motion', covering brand motion principles and how the brand typography is allowed to animate. Deep purple/indigo background with white and light-grey text and a clean geometric sans. The single technique worth stealing is the headline itself: a vertical looping text marquee built straight into the H1 ('Bringing agreements to …' cycling through a list), with soft easing and fades so the brand's dynamism is demonstrated in the copy rather than claimed. Useful reference for brand-guideline microsites that need to feel alive, and for anyone building an animated value-prop headline.

78343af1413f4ef58809ee6b755083be.description: Breaking is a Harvard/Colossal Biosciences spin-out commercialising X-32, a naturally derived microbe that degrades polyolefins, polyesters and nylon, branded as "Plastic Degradation™". The hero pairs huge display type with a kinetic vertical stack of low-opacity verbs (Digesting, Decomposing, Recycling, Reformulating, Reviving, Rebuilding) that cycles as you scroll, over organic wavy container masks that cut into the imagery, plus a deliberately pixel-art plastic bottle. Palette is electric blue and vivid yellow against muted earth tones. Awwwards Site of the Day badge on the hero. Strong reference for scrolltelling science storytelling and for mixing pixel/retro graphics into a serious biotech brand; the Science page is the strongest inner page.

d8166ebeafa64da2b313281e7dc9459a.description: BrewDistrict24 is a Dutch craft brewery from Nijmegen selling six classic beers direct to consumers; site by De Jongens van Boven. The age gate is itself a designed screen worth noting: cream ground, olive-gold and charcoal, a bold vintage-inspired display serif, dashed-border buttons and a strictly symmetrical layout. Behind it the site runs a six-beer product carousel where each can carries full specs (ingredients, ABV, EBC colour, IBU bitterness, calories, serving temperature) alongside sensory copy, plus a brand-story block about 'gezelligheid', a stockists marquee of cafes and shops, and a playful 'Click the can' page. Full hero visuals unverified (cookie-based age gate blocks the headless render), so hero type is left unset.

02fcd4afffdf40aba2b2c3b1577a8c3b.description: About page of Broworks, an enterprise Webflow development agency (founded 2019, Pancevo Serbia + Montreal, 30+ senior team) doing WordPress-to-Webflow migration, design, SEO/AEO, CRO and HubSpot work for SaaS and B2B; /about now 301s to /enterprise-webflow-development-agency — same page, slug renamed. Asymmetric split hero: oversized bold sans headline cropped at the top on a pale mint-white ground, near-black body copy in a monospaced typewriter face for a dev-focused feel, acid-yellow accent button and a rounded-corner team photo right. Notable blocks: two stacked comparison tables (Webflow vs WordPress, then Broworks vs Other Agencies vs In-House vs Freelancers), an unusual stats block, a leadership grid with bio popups, an office-life photo marquee and an awards row. Most novel is a 'Turn this into action with AI' CTA offering Ask Atlas / ChatGPT / Claude / Perplexity prompt shortcuts, plus an /llm-info page written for LLMs.

cb49d5a5e9b84e5282df2f56f4164da4.description: Portfolio of Bruno, a French branding agency with offices in Paris, Rouen, London and San Francisco, back online at its new domain (moved from callbruno.com). Ultra-minimal monochrome landing built on Framer: a centered logo and the grandpa-themed tagline float in extreme negative space, with navigation and city names pinned to the viewport edges. The page unfolds into a feed of case-study cards (Rimowa x Pokemon, Uber, Qonto, Cure51) mixed with news posts and draggable image sliders.

3a37b8e81d888047aa41efa737a732dc.description: Bucks Sauce Co. is a Philly-area small-batch BBQ and hot sauce brand with irreverent copy — "the BBQ sauce that makes other sauces insecure." Hero is a dark chocolate-black product carousel labelled "Product n0.0123" with the bottle centred on a golden-yellow circular backdrop, floating ingredient cutouts as flavour cues, and a heavy condensed sans headline that alternates filled and hollow letterforms word-by-word for rhythm. Notable blocks: a four-up ingredient-claims strip, a "Choose your weapon" product grid with inline add-to-cart and antler motifs, a numbered story trio, bundle upsells and a triple-row infinite testimonial marquee. Site by Buzzworthy Studio.

de23c9979e3e4771b9a83a8f1f99018b.description: Buddhapizza is a premium-casual pizza delivery brand in Odessa, built as a one-page ordering site by Solar Digital. The hero is a surrealist illustration set on pitch black — a third-eye pizza with ingredients floating outward in a radial composition, in tomato red, golden dough and leafy green — with tall condensed hand-lettering for the brand and slogans set as text-on-path curving around the centre. The standout block is "Check Your Karma", a random order generator that turns menu indecision into a brand mechanic. Award ribbons are drawn into the corner artwork instead of pasted on, and a minimal sidebar keeps the canvas clear. Reference for food delivery sites that lead with a concept instead of a product grid.

9bcde16df8e2434c93fa264bd11125b8.description: Official store for Bugatti Smartwatches (ceramic Ceramique and carbon-fiber Carbone limited editions, GPS and heart-rate sport tracking). The site currently opens on a dark warranty-notice landing rather than a normal storefront hero: deep black with crisp white type and a light-blue accent, a bold all-caps sans headline, a paragraph about honoring warranty commitments through 2026, and a 3D-style product render giving depth against the flat background. Reference for dark, high-contrast luxury-tech product presentation; note the current warranty-notice state.

16d7b8e81d8880cda50fc68704de0562.description: Burner (by Arx Research) is a credit-card-sized crypto hardware wallet for Bitcoin and Ethereum: tap it to your phone, no app, no seed phrase, plus a Terminal device for accepting stablecoins. Cream background, a lime-green card shot floating in a hand, high-contrast serif headlines paired with a monospaced nav in a floating pill bar, so it reads editorial rather than crypto-bro. The block worth stealing is the "Ok, it's not a fair comparison" table: a Before Burner / After Burner feature matrix that mocks legacy hardware wallets row by row (apps to install, seed phrases, colours, modifiable firmware) and does more competitive positioning than a whole page of copy. Also uses short looping product videos as section backgrounds.

0ceab8c669c1433bad454bbf364a71c0.description: Was: UI Kids, an interactive comic where UI elements (buttons, checkboxes, toggles) live as animated characters. The standalone experience is gone: buttons.evrone.com now redirects to a static article at evrone.com/blog/ui-kids that documents the project with comic strips and the concept. Screenshot shows the redirect target. Keep as a concept reference for personified UI storytelling; the live interactions are lost.

2887b8e81d8880eaa671f99eae5e4898.description: Caitlyn is a secure generative-AI knowledge platform deployed inside the customer's own AWS environment, turning agricultural research archives into cited, verifiable answers (customers include Beef+Lamb NZ, FAR, MPI, HortNZ). Copy-first minimal hero with no imagery at all: bold tight-tracked geometric sans in deep black on off-white, extreme whitespace, and a terminal period echoing the logo mark. The one clever move is a floating example-query chip sitting under the headline ("Which wheat varieties performed best...") that teases the product without a screenshot. Also runs a duplicated auto-scrolling customer-logo marquee and a gated 17-page info-pack CTA.

2fc7b8e81d8880c594f4c780151dee50.description: Baba Care matches US patients with a human healthcare advocate (nurses, case managers, social workers) who handles insurance, pre-authorisations, scheduling and bills, covered by Medicare. Built in Framer. The standout is the art direction: instead of clinical stock photography it uses a warm, hand-drawn illustration of migrating geese under a dusty-blue sky with mustard and lavender clouds, layered for depth, which lowers anxiety and funnels the eye to the CTA. Headlines are a high-contrast serif that italicises the emotional word ("Navigating healthcare is hard"). Also worth stealing: a 01-02-03 process section where each step card carries its own proof stat (+98% of patients feel less stress), a condition-tag grid (Cancer, Dementia, Parkinson's, Stroke recovery) that doubles as SEO landing pages, a national stats band (6,000+ families, 27+ years average advocate experience), and a plain-spoken FAQ that answers "Is Baba AI or humans?" head-on.

16c7b8e81d8880d2afc1db1e67053d39.description: cambiumcarbon.com now 301-redirects to cambium.com: the company rebranded from "Cambium Carbon" to "Cambium, the modern market for wood", an AI-driven marketplace and supply chain for salvaged and domestically sourced timber (Carbon Smart Wood, Arbor Wood, Zena, Richlite). The hero is a warm, earthy composition — deep chocolate-to-tan gradient, rust-orange CTAs, spaced all-caps labels over a lifestyle photo of wood samples, a plant and a tablet — with semi-transparent glassmorphic info chips ("Evaluating 380+ sources", species cards) tied by thin leader lines to points in the photo, a very stealable "tech layer mapped over a natural product" technique. Further down: a live supply-chain globe/dashboard that acts as a real product-UI demo with routes, nodes and carbon-impact panels, plus a featured-projects case grid tagged by location and application. Webflow build.

c27ff20fd27b4e6586c0974d461742e7.description: Portfolio of Camille Mormal, an independent interactive designer and art director focused on immersive, storytelling-driven web experiences. The value is in the inner pages, which are full case studies for major brands: Gucci (The Regeneration Suite with The Savoy), Swarovski Fine Interiors, Samsung (Spacial smartwatch concept), Sennheiser, Rituals, Moco Museum and Saeco, making it a strong reference for premium brand-experience art direction. Visuals unverified: both headless captures returned a hosting error/suspension page and the HTML fetch returned an empty body, so no hero, palette or typography details are claimed here and the record may need a re-check.

3a37b8e81d8880c4bcb9c0264c57cffa.description: Cantor8 sells enterprise blockchain infrastructure on the Canton Network to financial institutions — custody, token issuance, staking, validator nodes, private settlement. Hero is a deep cobalt-blue field with a left-aligned bold sans headline and a central abstract "signal map" data-viz graphic of delicate arcing lines and dots, annotated with tiny floating monospace micro-labels for a telemetry/systems feel. Notable blocks: a seven-card product-suite grid with pixelated arrow icons, a partner logos bar (Canton Network, Digital Asset, Oxford), a use-case accordion and a newsroom feed. Website by Artemii Lebedev.

34e7b8e81d888006be21db9d3c51b86f.description: B2B vendor financing platform (fintech). Split hero: heavy navy headline left, floating simplified UI cards with purple accent and soft shadows right, on white. Below: stat-led narrative sections (82%, 25% AOV), role-based feature blocks (Sales / Finance / Channel / Buyers) with product shots, platform capabilities with UI screenshots, testimonial cards, big stats band ($1.3T, $2B+, 10k+), awards and integration logos. Strong ref for trust-heavy fintech landings that sell with numbers instead of decoration.

e849fdd72c90457396ab125d3c109a87.description: Capsul'in Pro's 'Zero Impact' page presents the world's first OK-Compost-HOME-certified, 100% biobased, oxygen-barrier coffee capsule, compatible with Nespresso machines. Visuals unverified (loader in headless render): the scrolltelling page stayed on an animated loader during capture (soft peach topographic line-art background, dark-teal 'CI' speech-bubble logo, progress bar), so the full hero could not be confirmed. The loader palette matches the pastel, patterned, gradient aesthetic recorded for the site.

286a079f9ac5442cb6850d24519bf806.description: Cards Against Humanity's own store and brand site for the party card game. The design is deliberately anti-design: stark black-and-white, a utilitarian grotesque sans lifted straight off the physical cards, and oversized product shots of the cards themselves as the hero. The block genuinely worth stealing is the cookie consent modal — written entirely in the brand's irreverent voice ("Welcome to our stupid website!"), with a heavy gaussian blur on the hero behind it to isolate the modal. It turns a compliance requirement into a brand moment. Rest of the site is product tiles and shop flow. Good reference for how far a single-font monochrome system can carry a brand when the copy does the heavy lifting.

1461216ef25f4fa19674ae1bf48a13aa.description: CargoKite is a Munich maritime hardtech startup (founded 2022) building small autonomous cargo micro-ships propelled by high-altitude kites, backed by Lowercarbon, SOSV, Bayern Kapital and others. Awwwards-featured. Hero is a bird's-eye ocean video in deep teal and navy with a bold white headline and orange CTAs, plus an investor logo row directly under the headline for instant credibility. Notable blocks: a scroll-driven five-part problem list (why ocean shipping is broken), a horizontal 'paradigm shift' visual that swaps one large freighter for a fleet of small ships, a technology spec row (up to 100% wind propulsion, 70% fuel savings, 320 containers, semi-autonomous), a partners marquee, and an unusually long, genuinely useful FAQ. Strong reference for climate hardtech storytelling.

21e7b8e81d888004a156e195156c6c88.description: Cartesia builds real-time voice AI (Sonic TTS, Ink STT, Line voice agents) on State Space Models, founded by the Stanford PhDs behind Mamba. The hero is a centered announcement bar over a deep forest-green field with a looping dithered / checkered video texture inside a large rounded container; a traditional serif display headline paired with clean sans subcopy and outlined-plus-solid CTA buttons gives a heritage-meets-hi-tech feel. The most distinctive block is an industry switcher (Finance / Healthcare / Government) driving an illustrated isometric floor-plan where individual rooms light up per use case (fraud detection, collections, compliance) — a genuinely unusual interactive diagram. Also an Artificial Analysis "Ranked #1" customer bar, video-backed model cards, and hoverable cloud / on-prem / on-device deployment tiles. Dither and halftone motion textures run throughout the brand.

82eb9bd257de4996b972c9ae09a3537e.description: Casa di Solare is a boutique luxury villa and stay experience in the Philippines, positioned as an Italian-inspired, sun-drenched retreat. Photo-led hero (architectural shot of the property) over a palette of warm neutrals — cream and beige with a vibrant sun-yellow accent — an elegant high-contrast serif for headings and a minimal sans for body. The move worth stealing is the arch motif: it comes from the logo and the building's real architecture and gets reused as the splash-screen shape and as a layout device, so the brand mark and the property reinforce each other. Airy minimal layout, heavy whitespace, photography doing the selling. Note: the live site reads as hospitality, which does not match the existing Font tag — worth a manual re-check.

c877ff7c9f3c44c0a7cf1c4bed2431fd.description: CaveWorld (Crypto Cavemen Club) is a turn-based PvP arena game on Solana built in Unreal Engine, with a $CAVE economy covering battle, crafting, exploration and trading. The site is a prehistoric-diorama scrolltelling experience: layered parallax PNG scenery (cave mouths, bushes, branches, potions, dinosaur heads) builds depth per section, backed by an audio layer and a numbered radial menu where each item sits on its own leaf. Worth stealing: the NFT marquee wall of character art, the four paths-to-power cards each anchored by a floating weapon render, and a pricing block that sells account tiers (free practice / competitive / NFT holder) as roleplay rather than SKUs. Site by estudio/nk. Visuals unverified (audio gate plus an app error state in headless render).

34e7b8e81d88801886d2f275284f281b.description: Cernel (Aarhus, DK; €4M seed) automates ecommerce product onboarding: data enrichment, AI media content, translations and channel feed optimization for retailers like Vero Moda and Matas. Dark hero with bold sans headline, acid-yellow announcement bar and CTAs, delicate dot-grid texture, and floating product-pipeline UI cards teasing the platform. Long "how it works" narrative with agent-reasoning hover states on product attributes, before/after media-content cards (packshot → on-model → seasonal), percentage-driven benefit cards (-85% manual work), a video testimonial and a founder-vision letter. Good reference for storytelling a data/AI pipeline visually.

13118d650b6843c8a799f3dc1f25893f.description: ChainZoku is a Web3 collectible-character project with lore, mini-games and a customisation ecosystem. Opens with a floating 3D logo that transitions seamlessly into a detailed 3D street scene (characters at a vending machine), lime green highlights against shifting dark navy, deep red and white, with a distorted chunky display font over heavy bold sans. Steal-worthy: kinetic lore blocks where slanted black text panels pop in to make long-form story punchy; characters revealed through animated star and geometric masks; a game-inventory-style customisation UI that lets you preview items on a character; and a persistent PLAY video window pinned bottom-right. Strong hybrid 2D/3D approach blending flat graphic stickers with high-end character renders.

33e7b8e81d888079ac38ea8db1af852f.description: Champions for Good Club is a German members club (Webflow) connecting elite athletes with entrepreneurs and investors through sport events and matchmaking. The hero is pure big-type brutalism: ultra-condensed italic caps reading YOUR NETWORK OF GAME CHANGERS on a deep plum background, with smaller words nested into the negative space of the giant headline and a cursor-driven image trail of athlete photos. The whole site is sound-reactive, with a Sounds toggle in the nav and a per-sport audio library (tennis, fencing, basketball, bobsleigh) triggered on hover. Notable blocks: a five-tier membership pricing grid (Athlete free / Booster / Business / Corporate / Partner) with sport-pictogram icons, a vertically stacked kinetic-type mission statement, a values list, community testimonial video cards from Olympic athletes, and a benefits list. Site by Double Play. Strong reference for kinetic typography, sticker graphics and audio-driven interaction.

3687b8e81d88802cb71ecbdc7aea03e5.description: ChatLabs is an AI campaign-asset platform for brands: one product upload becomes on-brand visuals for PDPs, ads, social and email across fashion, beauty, electronics and F&B. Dark hero in charcoal with crisp white display type and "safety orange" accents, split with a fashion photo that carries floating AI-UI overlays (model/scene selection) demonstrating the product in place; vertical orange bars add an editorial glitch accent. Three-step process (brand → product → generate), industry tabs, "Only real outputs. No retouching." gallery and feature cards for brand consistency and AI campaign briefs.

750302a8131848be8b00f571f65edfca.description: Portfolio of Chiara Luzzana, an award-winning Italian sound designer working in sound branding, composition, soundtracks and audio installations for Swatch, Alessi, Lavazza, Nivea and Costa. The /work page is a numbered project index on a warm bone off-white background with black ink, using oversized elongated-serif numerals as architectural elements and condensed editorial brand titles like a fashion masthead; hairline vertical rules build the grid without visual weight and hand-drawn sketchy marks soften the rigidity. Roman-numeral navigation and a "rotate your device" prompt signal a deliberately art-directed, orientation-aware build. Each case study (/work/swatch, /work/alessi) is a full audio-led project story. Webflow.

c95f4877402749048ae4b0137ebfc3fe.description: Chirpley is an AI-driven influencer-marketing / Web3 platform (existing tags point to a pastel, 3D, fun, scrolltelling build).
