Notable blocks: a client logos bar (Financial Times, Axel Springer, Bolt, DeepL, Simmons & Simmons), a three-step tabbed how-it-works walkthrough, a six-card governance grid, a named partner testimonial with office photography, a tools vs outcomes argument block, and a FAQ. Good reference for enterprise AI trust-building and dark-mode legal-tech positioning.

907759e0657f4859b8e95eedfe56b5d0.description: Flareum pitches itself as a font/typography management tool — 'your entire typography universe, now conveniently in one place'. The site is a heavy WebGL showpiece: a cinematic eclipse-style circular loader with a numeric counter, then a monochrome black-and-white big-type hero where the headline is masked behind environmental silhouettes (mountains, moon) scrolling at different speeds to fake depth. The typography itself is the demo: variable-font characters morph in weight and width as you scroll. It even ships a 'Low FPS detected' prompt offering to downgrade visuals. Note: only the hero rendered reliably in a headless capture, so blocks below the fold are unverified.

47af6eedf221410e90364fbaba76aac9.description: Flecto is a Portuguese all-in-one rental management platform (inventory, bookings, payments, insurance, marketplace) positioned around the circular economy. The hero is a modular illustration scene rather than a screenshot dump: deep forest green and vibrant neon mint, bold tight-tracked sans, with 'circuit board' pathways connecting small UI snippets (chat, store listing, insurance icons) to map the whole product ecosystem in one image. The container is a large irregular rounded geometric shape that carves out distinctive negative space for the nav, and minimal controls are tucked into the outer corners. Best block is a stepped interactive demo (01 Channels & Security → 02 SaaS → 03 Flecto Link) running a face-scan-to-pay flow. Also: press logos bar (Forbes, TechCrunch), backer logos (Techstars, Maze) and CO2-savings stats. Site by Burocratik.

9036a7d7afe14f5fa2925785c3fa834b.description: Fledge (Fledge EURL, France) is a talent-acquisition and talent-management consultancy that finds niche tech talent in Europe and the US for startups, split across For Companies and For Candidates tracks. The hero pairs a deep forest-green background with a cream ultra-condensed sans headline (“Talent acquisition strategy for Tech companies”) where a single word is italicised for emphasis, plus a lime-green logo and soft pink organic shapes layered over the sharp-edged photo to break the grid. Worth stealing: the extreme condensed weight mixed with italics inside one headline to steer focus, and the moody-dark + pastel-accent pairing that reads premium rather than corporate. Notable blocks: a large Simon Sinek pull-quote block, a values grid (Talent-Focused / Passionate / Humble / Rational), an insights-and-articles feed, and a client logos bar (OLX, Criteo, Wallapop, Onfido, sennder).

16c7b8e81d88808ba40be85650b48c02.description: Fleishigs is a monthly kosher food and lifestyle magazine ("a non-traditional magazine for the people of tradition") sold in Barnes & Noble and Whole Foods, with a paid subscription, a back-issue store and a companion recipe app. The hero turns the product into the background: an angled photo of the open printed magazine under a muted teal-grey wash, a heavy condensed all-caps sans headline layered over it, and a floating subscription offer card sitting on top so the hero doubles as a point of sale. Safety-orange bars and buttons cut against an otherwise editorial serif voice. Notable blocks: an issue-cover grid with per-issue buy buttons, a video-backed app promo, a "Foodies have spoken" testimonial rail with chef portraits, and a press logos bar (NYT, MSN, WGN9, KTLA). Site by Mann Sales Co. and Widelab.

3687b8e81d88809ea778c9815da9707e.description: Portuguese manufacturer of sustainable urban furniture and signage (est. 2007), site by Buro. Ultra-minimal warm beige hero with a single brand statement and pill-shaped nav containers; numbered collection chapters 01-05 (Urban, Nature, RePlastic, Golf, Details) with product counts and catalog downloads, recent news feed, founder quote, design-build-implement triptych. Strong ref for calm premium catalog sites and eco-positioned manufacturers.

1d07b8e81d88807db6aad22e1c43e4a6.description: Flourish Commerce is a US eCommerce CRO and Shopify design/dev studio selling a productised conversion audit (plans from $99). Webflow build on a warm cream base with a large editorial serif headline, charcoal type and a green accent. The single best block is the annotated audit preview directly under the hero: a real product page with numbered hotspots, each expanding into a recommendation tagged with Effort and Impact ratings, which sells the deliverable better than any copy. Also strong: a 3-step process strip, an interactive ROI calculator where you enter conversion rate, AOV and sessions and it computes the revenue you are leaving on the table, a client logo bar (Helinox, Grüns, Dandi), a testimonial carousel with case-study cards, and a two-founder team block. Excellent reference for productised-service pages.

2497b8e81d8880c3aabfed83ebe58cdc.description: FlowFest is a non-profit, community-run outdoor conference for Webflow designers and developers (Manchester, August, keynote by Vlad Magdalin, sponsored by Osmo and Webflow), built in Webflow itself. Vibrant retro 70s-sunset hero in cream, salmon pink, goldenrod and orange, with heavy bubble-style display type carrying thick black outlines and offset shadows, and a subhead set in chunky white on a tilted orange sticker block. The whole design leans on a sticker aesthetic: layered outlines and drop shadows for tactile physicality, bold multi-colour retro stripes framing the viewport, tilted geometric shapes and high-contrast neo-brutalist borders. Notable blocks: speaker lineup as team, a tweet wall used as testimonials, and a photo gallery from past editions.

529c59d53e9047f8810d14aa3352ffb2.description: HYER (formerly ENVOY) is a Netherlands-based private-jet charter broker in Eindhoven offering on-demand booking, shared per-seat flights, fractional ownership, memberships and now Hyer Stays, a hotel and travel arm; built on Next.js + DatoCMS. Visuals unverified (a Next.js client-side exception threw on both headless render attempts instead of painting the page), so no palette, typography or hero details are claimed here. From HTML: the page leads with a Beyond Travel. headline over Stays/Travel CTAs, then a four-up value-prop row (Carefully Selected / Smart Technology / Flexible by Design / Personal Support), a destination gallery of European city cards (Barcelona, Ibiza, Cannes, Paris) labelled with airport codes, a personal Flight Manager support block, and a clouds-image closing CTA.

8505abb416e34ea88c6a88817b700667.description: Rolling papers and smoking accessories e-commerce with loud streetwear energy. Big-type hero with playful duplicated-word animations ('I'm I'm fly! fly!'), ultra-bold condensed display face, purple-yellow palette, cheeky copy per category (rolls, grinders, cones, tips). Branded age gate with a Kilroy-style mascot peeking over the type, hands clipping onto letterforms - a ref in itself. Promo cards (referral, affiliate, Ibiza contest). Screenshot currently shows the age gate.

580b54cded354ea2a322674a5163c94f.description: Platoon Aviation, a luxury private jet charter operator. Full-screen hero photograph of the aircraft in a dark studio with a reflective floor and low-key lighting, palette held to black, white and soft greys. High-contrast serif carries branding and headline for a luxury editorial feel, with a clean sans for functional UI. Oversized, partially cropped typography along the bottom edge adds a contemporary touch to an otherwise classic premium treatment. Good reference for dark studio product photography and restrained monochrome luxury branding.

6c31251b28d04095ae627af2056eb091.description: Fold7 — London creative and advertising agency. The entry screen is one idea executed hard: the FOLD7 wordmark set in a heavy tightly-tracked uppercase display face is used as a mask, with a fast-cut showreel montage playing through the letterforms against a clean white page. Footage cycles through cinematic campaign work (including Mads Mikkelsen for Carlsberg), urban greys and browns, warm golden-hour cityscapes and saturated character animation, so the type doubles as the portfolio. Strong reference for video-in-type masking as a full-screen agency intro. Sections below the masked hero unverified in headless render.

416b1df7eb8b4f2eb34feb8fe8a8b3b6.description: Type specimen and launch site for July 01, a high-contrast Bodoni-inspired display serif by Danilo De Marco / Studio K95 (named after his wedding date, 1 July 2022). The hero turns the typeface into architecture: enormous vermilion and black glyphs sandwich a surreal monochrome photo (an astronaut reading a newspaper), producing real layered depth. Palette is vermilion, stark white and black; the display serif is paired with a plain functional sans in the header. Good reference for font-launch pages and any project that wants type-as-hero with editorial imagery. Featured on Awwwards-adjacent inspiration lists.

46f8786064f74700808c1d23e9129ac5.description: Fontshare is Indian Type Foundry's free quality-font service (100+ families, free for personal and commercial use via CSS embed or download). Rather than a marketing hero it opens straight into a utilitarian catalog: a monochrome cream-and-black grid UI with an extensive filter system (search, categories, properties, a live size slider, alignment and dark-mode toggles) over a large font-specimen grid. Reference for functional, filter-driven directory/catalog interfaces.

3687b8e81d8880c3850fd9f2c4e3ad96.description: Framer-built landing for a white-label community platform (courses, events, members). Dark hero: large light-weight sans headline over a soft gradient-mesh glow, product dashboard cropped at the fold as a scroll cue, grass-hill cutout images framing sections. Below: tabbed feature showcase with UI screenshots, alternating feature cards, 3-tier pricing, tabbed FAQ accordion, blog cards. Strong ref for SaaS landings with atmospheric dark gradients and partial product reveal.

e723198cdd1443c98cd845432f3ceb27.description: Foreverbots is a gamified NFT project built around 5,000 animated 3D robot companions with collectible achievements. High-contrast purple, neon yellow, electric blue and orange, with bold sans mixed against 8-bit pixel type, which is a clean way to signal retro gaming without going full nostalgia. 3D scene hero with animated robot renders, retro-gaming UI chrome, scrolling marquees and a pricing/mint block. Credited to Oscar Pettersson and Kevin Olberg.

16c7b8e81d88803cbee3c1968f693ca5.description: Hers is the women's arm of Hims & Hers: telehealth for weight loss (GLP-1s), hair regrowth, menopause, mental health, skin and at-home lab testing, all prescribed online. The hero is a modular asymmetric card grid rather than a single image — each card is one service line, sized by priority, mixing clinical product shots with joyful lifestyle photography, so a very broad catalogue stays navigable. Wellness palette of cream, sage, lavender and peach with a bold serif headline against a functional sans. Strongest inner blocks: a GLP-1 comparison rail with FDA-approved badges and per-month pricing, an inline eligibility quiz, a scrolling 130+ biomarker visualiser for the Labs product, a "Biological Age" reveal, before/after testimonial cards with duration and treatment stated, and a credentialed medical-team block. Reference-grade for regulated healthcare UX and disclaimer handling.

cd56eded3c5d49fe88d7a6d0fd46d52f.description: Formcarry is a form backend that handles HTML form submissions, spam filtering and integrations without any server-side code. Crisp white and soft lavender with dark navy accents and a bold modern sans. Playful-technical mix: 3D Memoji characters, layered floating UI cards and scroll-triggered transitions. Structurally interesting for a small SaaS: an interactive demo sits high on the page and an FAQ closes it out, with the product UI showcase doing the explaining in between.

3687b8e81d8880889b2dc818826a1f5a.description: AI product-visual generator for e-commerce (London): upload one product shot and get PDP images, lifestyle scenes, UGC-style content and video. Hero pairs a big statement ("Your catalog, instantly re-shot.") with a photo collage in organic soft-edged masks (squircles, pebbles) plus a functional "upload your assets" tile blended into the collage — nice inspiration-to-action bridge. Floating pill navigation, before/after image swaps in the gallery, a four-step numbered process with code-like labels (PB/GO/CB/AX), cheeky FAQ ("Not AI-gen answers. Real ones here."). Submitted to Awwwards.

1f0e617982e741f68bba500f43f03f53.description: Frame.io is a cloud collaboration platform for creative teams to upload, manage and review video and design assets, now part of Adobe. Sleek dark mode with vibrant neon purple and blue gradients and a clean high-contrast sans. Split hero pairing copy with product imagery. Notable: large-scale data visualisations used to punctuate feature benefits rather than decorate them, and product UI showcase blocks that demonstrate the review workflow instead of describing it.

5ba73a71c47e423ea98706201a61db5d.description: Framer is a no-code AI website design and publishing tool aimed at designers and teams. The homepage uses a stacked dark-mode hero: a bold geometric sans headline and CTA buttons centred above a large high-fidelity screenshot of the Framer canvas itself — an app-within-an-app reveal that sells the product by showing it. The palette is near-black and white with vivid blue interactive accents, very high contrast and minimal chrome. Strong reference for product-UI-led SaaS heroes, template galleries and dark editorial marketing pages.

16c7b8e81d888013b4c4da87b7d4d810.description: Front is an AI customer-operations and shared-inbox platform (omnichannel ticketing, Autopilot, Copilot, smart QA and CSAT) aimed at complex B2B support teams. The hero is typography-led and centered on a deep eggplant-purple field: a huge tightly-kerned sans headline that names the competitor category head-on, a white pill primary CTA against a ghost secondary, and a small rotating keyword marquee (cross-team coordination / multi-step workflows / AI command center) that adds motion without a video. Below it: a three-up problem statement, large product-UI screens per pillar, a G2/Capterra award badge wall, a teams card grid, a testimonial carousel with customer logos and a 160+ integration logo cloud. Strong inner pages: a full compare hub (vs Zendesk, Intercom, Help Scout, Pylon) and the "Coordination Tax" research report microsite.

2497b8e81d8880f8bb4bcf099ebfd420.description: Frontify is a brand management and DAM platform ("brand intelligence for the AI era") used by Microsoft, Uber, OpenAI, Kia, Lufthansa and Budweiser. The hero is a full-bleed atmospheric landscape photograph — dark midnight-blue sky fading into warm earthy orange rocky mountains — carrying a large elegant high-contrast serif headline: an editorial, high-end brand feel that is rare in B2B SaaS, paired with a clean sans nav. Below it, a sequence of animated product-UI demos: auto-tagging asset grids with live "metadata generating…" states, a fake AI search box with filter chips, a template variable editor and a Brand Assistant chat mock. Video testimonial cards from Uber, Kia and Skyscanner brand leads. Strong inner pages: the builtwith.frontify.com showcase gallery and the "Kitchen" experiments section. Note: hero partly obscured by the Cookiebot modal in headless render, so visual details are from a partial view plus HTML.

027ef42a6a414d7cad9f3d1101912cf8.description: Fruitful is a personal finance platform that pairs users with a 1-on-1 CFP-certified human 'Guide' and automates a personal money system across income, bills, spending, saving and investing. The hero is centred big type ('Your money, finally figured out.') over a forest-green and white palette, with cream, mint and peach pastel sections lower down. The block worth stealing is the 'How it works' Process walkthrough, which step-transitions from portraits of the human Guides into product UI mockups, visually welding advisor to app. Also strong: a node-based 'Money Map' diagram that makes automated fund routing legible at a glance, an iPhone mockup with an illustrated lock screen ('Your paycheck arrived!'), a Trustpilot/awards stat strip, a testimonial grid and a 'Meet your Guide' team block.

44c17f56b9ff4871b7efd357307ba6ab.description: Fuente Real, boutique holiday apartments in Comillas, northern Spain. The hero is type-led and quiet: large elegant serif titles framed by thin horizontal rules, a centred logo and generous white space, on a muted earthy palette of sage green, cream and tan. Serif carries brand and headings while a cleaner sans handles UI. The notable component is a minimal segmented booking widget stretched across the full width of the hero, a good pattern for hospitality sites that need a reservation entry point without breaking a refined layout.

fad5766d1b5f4b899991f7b44f276ade.description: Future Goals is a Caribbean-wide initiative started in Curacao that turns ocean-recovered fishing nets and plastic waste into colourful football goals, initiated by AFC Ajax and Sandals Resorts with adidas as main sponsor and local recycler Limpi manufacturing. The hero is a centred full-screen typographic statement on a deep textured oceanic teal, with cream type and a vibrant orange-to-green gradient bar anchoring the bottom. Notable craft: a grain/noise overlay plus soft bokeh and gradients that simulate underwater depth, and a playful bubbly retro-grotesque logo paired with a heavy rounded geometric sans. Good reference for sustainability and NGO campaign sites with tactile, atmospheric backgrounds.

8d295bd8a8cf458aa71b0c0be792d227.description: Fuzzball is a subscription pet brand, and the hero runs a warm lifestyle photo behind bold rounded sans type in deep navy, warm cream and high-contrast sky blue, with a hand-drawn yellow brushstroke under the headline to soften the corporate edge. The conversion mechanics are the interesting part: a name/email input sits directly in the hero to collapse the funnel, and the primary button uses visible price anchoring (struck-through £16 next to £8 today) to drop the barrier at the exact point of decision. Worth stealing for any DTC subscription hero. A promo popup partially covers the fold on load.

2147b8e81d8880c0bd1ac0aaeb7c6a93.description: Gamma is an AI design tool (50M+ users) that generates presentations, websites, documents, social posts and graphics from a prompt or an outline. The hero is a split layout — a bold heavy geometric sans headline on a clean white canvas at left, and at right a rotating carousel of surrealist product artworks (stippled 3D mushrooms, botanical plates, a hot-air balloon) with floating UI tooltips and collaborator cursors layered on top: the standout technique is demonstrating the product through rich editorial illustration rather than dry screenshots. Palette is white plus deep midnight blue with electric cyan, magenta and lime. Notable blocks: a looping horizontal marquee of product cards, a Generate-Shape-Share trio each driven by an inline MP4 of the app in use, a logos bar (Amazon, Adobe, Vercel, Stanford) and a very large multi-column testimonial wall with bolded pull-phrases.

16c7b8e81d8880c5aefcd87e37dd7595.description: Gelato La Boca is a Dallas gelato shop bringing Argentinian artisanal gelato from Buenos Aires, with a shop, a gelato cart and event catering. The hero is a full-bleed background video of fans in Argentina jerseys behind a massive outlined rounded sans headline "From Buenos Aires to Dallas", on a golden-yellow / black / cream palette with a jagged sticker-style GLB badge and a retro 3D-extruded block logo. The outlined-type-over-footage trick keeps the headline loud without hiding the subjects, and a 112-frame PNG sequence animates a Fiat gelato cart as you scroll. Notable blocks: a flavor gallery with hand-shot scoops, a large Instagram grid ("Never Gelato Solo") used as social proof, and a newsletter capture; strong inner pages for Flavors, Events and Locations.

90e658fd628f42469c56852501ab8791.description: Production site of GenCell, an Israeli maker of hydrogen and ammonia fuel-cell power solutions (moved from the dead staging URL gencell.preprodenv.com). Cinematic full-screen video hero of aerial forest footage under massive duplicated "Power for humanity" typography, in a palette of deep greens with brilliant white type. Notable are the numbered expandable solution sections ([01]-[04] accordions), a numbered product index (EVOX, BOX, FOX, REX) and arrow-prefixed ghost CTAs throughout.

dd28fde6328546e6b257149eedb2afd4.description: Genie is a procurement / ordering platform. The hero is high-contrast and direct — white ground, charcoal text, vibrant brand orange, a lavender announcement banner — with a bold geometric sans headline. Worth stealing: action-oriented color emphasis where brand orange highlights only the verbs ("track, plan, and order") so the product's core utility reads in a single glance; the "peek" effect with a partial product mockup at the bottom edge as a scroll cliffhanger; and a discreet top-right news banner that carries company updates without competing with the value proposition.

16c7b8e81d888078abfffe558bc3389a.description: Genius.Space is a Ukrainian online education platform (Kyiv, founded 2013) selling career-change courses in marketing, design, IT, business, finance and AI, with UA/RU locales. The hero pairs a big two-tone bold sans headline (orange-red plus deep blue on white) built on a rotating-phrase construction with three vertical pill-shaped image masks holding a golden-hour Kyiv panorama, and lets the headline overlap the first mask to break the grid — the most transferable idea on the page. A large semi-transparent play button sits in the center mask, micro social proof (star rating, 1900+ reviews, avatar stack) sits directly under the CTA, and a magenta promo bar with a countdown timer is docked at the bottom of the hero. Below: category-filtered course grids, an upcoming-webinar calendar with speaker portraits, a dense testimonial wall, big stats (60,000+ graduates, 92 countries), student success-story cards and an employer logos bar.

16c7b8e81d8880bcb7c8dacfce542dc7.description: Genius Sports is a London-based, NYSE-listed sports data, analytics and technology company (Perform, Engage, Bet and GeniusIQ product lines) serving leagues, sportsbooks, brands and broadcasters. The hero is a centered oversized geometric-sans headline ("The operating system of modern sport") on a deep midnight-navy field with an electric brand blue accent, held together almost entirely by negative space — a stark white-on-navy palette that reads premium and authoritative without any imagery. A sliver of the brand-film thumbnail peeks above the fold as a scroll tease. The strongest block is a logo/quote hybrid where each client testimonial is anchored by a large brand mark (Coca-Cola, NFL, Premier League, Sheffield United) that links straight into a full case study. Strong inner pages: /perform, /engage/fanhub, /bet, /customer-stories.

34e7b8e81d8880df99f7f6797eb1dd6e.description: Cluster (getcluster.ai) gives AI agents GTM infrastructure to run outbound sales. Fully JS-rendered site; the captured hero is a premium dark-mode composition: charcoal background, elegant serif headline with metallic-gold accent phrases, and a product mockup where glowing nodes and thin connecting lines visualize agent orchestration. Low-profile navigation and soft glows around UI elements give a high-end fintech-like feel. Little static HTML to index, so the value here is the hero art direction: serif + gold on black.

2147b8e81d88801faf9aeab7da019a41.description: Frankli is an Irish performance-management and employee-engagement SaaS for SMBs — 1-on-1s, OKRs, continuous feedback and HR analytics, positioned as a replacement for annual reviews. The hero is an illustrated storytelling scene: a dark-teal ground with a muted earthy palette (lilac, mint, terracotta), an elegant high-contrast serif headline against a clean sans nav, and hand-drawn blueprint line art where personas and data viz sit inside geometric windows with dotted path lines guiding the eye. The strongest steal-worthy block is the stats section — three big HR-research percentages (70% / 52% / 45%), each paired with a plain-language explanation of the underlying manager problem, so it reads as problem framing rather than a vanity-metrics row. Also notable: an autoplaying product video, a G2 trophy cluster and quirky illustrated hand SVGs framing the final CTA.

3a37b8e81d8880048d3ed36e79e8f95a.description: Get Hyped is a Dutch social-first content agency (strategy, content creation, activation, data), Dutch-language on Webflow. The hero is big-type driven — "Get Hyped. Get Noticed. Get Results." in a thick geometric sans at massive scale with tight leading on warm cream — flanked by tilted overlapping stat cards (10M+ organic views, 30+ brands) that each carry an autoplaying vertical video loop, plus electric blue, mint and pink accents. Below: numbered 01–04 expertise blocks with their own looping video, a case rail of vertical social work, a client logos bar and an inline contact-form modal. Strong inner pages at /work and /expertises. Design by Dylan Brouwer.

34e7b8e81d8880638a28debd98c638ab.description: Rally (Y Combinator-backed, Rally Europe B.V.) is a Visa-powered fleet fuel/EV-charging card with real-time spend controls, fraud alerts and AI receipt-to-ledger accounting for European fleets. Split hero: bold sans headline and signup left, aerial road photography right, with glassmorphic transaction cards floating over the imagery; trust badges (YC, GDPR/SOC2) sit right under the CTA. Notable blocks: a with/without "chat notification" comparison, animated counter stats, industry card carousel (Logistics, Taxis, Government), and a Rally-vs-traditional-fleet-cards comparison table. 16-locale language switcher in the nav.

eec8f59c4f1a4a6a956c90f850af7b3c.description: GG Aide is a Quebec charity gaming event ("Célébrons 30 ans de création de jeux vidéos au Québec", held at MILA + online, presented by lg2 in aid of Centraide du Grand Montréal). The hero is a tactile 3D scene: a claymation-textured game-controller character centred on a duotone yellow/black canvas, flanked by an oversized vertically stacked grotesque title that creates strong asymmetric balance. Notable blocks are the schedule/timeline (Horaire), speaker line-up and the partner logo wall. Good reference for a fun, DIY-feeling 3D character hero and for high-contrast duotone event branding without looking cheap.

53577a46775f4db889347e318e502292.description: Gitness (Harness Open Source) is an end-to-end open-source software delivery platform combining Git source management, cloud development environments, CI/CD pipelines and an artifact registry. The design is driven almost entirely by typography: a massive grotesk headline owns the first viewport and oversized type keeps acting as the layout skeleton further down. Palette is high-contrast monochrome grayscale with soft-glow lighting and light glassmorphism, plus abstract 3D light-path shapes in the background that add depth without competing with the text. The Product UI showcase is the block to study — cloud IDE and registry dashboard screenshots are composited so they read as native parts of the page rather than pasted-in images.

f1a37d2a4f0640b1ab8df0563d961b5d.description: Portfolio of Giulia Gartner, an outdoor, travel and commercial photographer and filmmaker based in the Dolomites. The hero is a full-bleed landscape photo with massive high-contrast serif type set over it, and the whole image sits inset inside a dark charcoal frame with rounded corners, giving the page a gallery-print feel rather than an edge-to-edge web look. Palette is moody oceanic blue and teal pulled straight from the photography, with off-white type and pill-shaped nav buttons as the only UI. Split into Stills and Motion sections with individual project pages per shoot or film. Good reference for photo-led personal branding where the typography carries the editorial voice.

3177b8e81d8880dba3e8eb9a98a7f89e.description: Glyphic Biotechnologies (Berkeley, founded 2021) is building ProSE, Protein Sequencing by Expansion, the first de novo high-throughput proteome sequencing method able to discriminate all 20 amino acids plus post-translational modifications at single-molecule sensitivity. The site is clinical and precise: stark white and charcoal with silver-grey, a light-weight grotesque set against hairline borders and a blueprint-like grid, plus a looping molecular sequencing video behind the hero. The signature move is an interactive numbered stepper on the right that walks the three-stage science (Sample Preparation, Molecular Expansion, Amino Acid Sequencing) as you scroll, turning a hard technical process into a legible narrative. Other notable blocks: a scrolling patent marquee of granted US patent numbers used as proof rather than a logo bar, a company/about chapter, and a live open-roles list with salary bands. Site by Obys. Strong reference for deep-tech and biotech explanation UX.

2e799c3209a64ef1a07ba13a51faede6.description: Aro (by Reclaimwell) sells a phone-free habit system: an app that tracks and gamifies off-screen time, plus an optional physical Aro box that acts as a visual cue, charges the phone and rewards intentional time away from it. Positioning is family- and parent-first rather than generic screen-time blocking, with dedicated audience sections For Parents, For Kids, For Churches (a church-led Digital Fast) and For Schools — a good reference for one product split into four audience narratives. Notable blocks: a stats row (1 hr 59 min reclaimed daily, 8 hrs 50 min of rest nightly, share of users who are parents), an app/box two-up product explainer, and an unusually dense testimonial wall mixing App Store reviews with named parent creators and photos. Visuals unverified (the headless render returned a Framer platform page).

1d07b8e81d88804abcd2f8dcfaab7f20.description: Gocertify is a UK reward-management platform that lets retailers run verified, gated offers for specific communities (students, NHS staff, key workers, seniors, under-26s) and keep the shopper data instead of leaking it to voucher sites. Webflow build with a live WebGL shader light-ray background behind the hero. Centered big-type hero on cream with a soft announcement pill above and a saturated indigo CTA; the social-proof number ("500+ brands") is baked into the H1 in a contrasting colour. Best block is the problem/solution comparison, a broken voucher-code visual on one side against the brand-owned on-site widget on the other, closed out with hard conversion metrics (9% AOV lift, 58% new-customer rate, 18% conversion). Retail logo bar carries Samsung, HP, H&M, Farfetch, Currys and boohoo.

2cd7b8e81d888097b9d5f1d528c6c463.description: Daylight (godaylight.com) is a decentralised home-energy company: battery plus solar plus smart software, sold as a subscription with no upfront cost, white-glove install, lifetime maintenance, and Sun Points rewards for supporting the grid. The hero is a warm autumnal photograph of a home with a subtle grid overlaying live smart-home widgets (thermostat, energy stats) directly onto the image, so the product's utility is visible before a single feature is named. Palette is rust, deep green and wood tones with a safety-orange accent; a high-contrast serif headline sits over a functional sans for the data. Worth stealing: the glassmorphism address field that qualifies the visitor right in the hero (a lead-gen move disguised as a product interaction), and the compact pill-shaped floating nav. Also has an estimate tool, referral/ambassador program ($750 per install) and community.

34e7b8e81d88802292bad06ce419cc6d.description: US telehealth pharmacy (GLP-1 weight loss, sexual health, daily wellness, hair) with a 100% online prescription flow. Hero uses soft-focus earthy lifestyle photography (moss greens, warm beiges) under a large sans headline, with a floating "Most Popular" product card overlapping the hero — a clean bridge from mood imagery to conversion. Long product-card sections per category with Rx badges and safety-information links, Trustpilot/testimonial screenshots, a numbered 3-step "How it works", health-guide article cards and a detailed FAQ. Good reference for healthcare e-commerce UI that stays warm rather than clinical.

f4a281ccf3dd41429d859737cb2ac394.description: Franchise site for Grab&Go, Europe's largest automated (vending) store chain, 200+ stores in Portugal, 400+ products, open 24/7. Site by Büro / Burocratik, featured on Awwwards. The hero is a rich illustrated street scene in brand orange, sunny yellow, earthy brown and forest green, built in parallax layers (railings in front, architecture behind) with an animated 24h storefront logo and a floating video teaser. Notable blocks: an animated store counter, a four-card franchise economics block (low investment from 13,900 EUR, ROI, low fixed costs, ~2h/day), a 3-step 'business in your hand' process, a support/marketing/partner-network grid, and a beach-scene closing CTA.

21e7b8e81d8880d5ac3df6ead0f21583.description: gradient.ai now 301-redirects to hyperagent.com — the company rebranded from Gradient / Superagent to Hyperagent, a "fleet of agents" platform that ships real deliverables (websites, video, decks, dashboards) straight into Slack or your inbox. The hero is a centered product-led composition: layered, overlapping app windows with soft drop shadows floating on a rich golden-ochre radial gradient, a high-contrast bold sans headline with tight leading, and a stark black CTA. The standout block is an auto-scrolling marquee of real "artifact" cards, each stamped with its runtime and dollar cost (e.g. "8m / $6.41") — an unusual and very steal-worthy way to price-tag work samples. Also a tabbed format switcher (Websites / Video / Slides / Documents / Dashboards) and inline product videos for the three-step "brief once, ship forever" flow.

a3a90c83007a414da84403cecf7ea34b.description: Grand Leisure is Poolsuite's NFT avatar project built as "The Ralph Lauren Expansion Pack" — a collision of Ralph Lauren's heritage-preppy elegance with Poolsuite's sun-bleached, martini-forward irreverence, positioned as a platform for thousands of leisure-inclined people to reimagine media, fashion and collaboration. A sub-experience lives at leisurist.grandleisure.org. Useful mainly as a reference for luxury-brand-meets-internet-subculture positioning and retro-leisure art direction where the whole site is written in-character rather than as product marketing. Visuals unverified (fully client-rendered; nothing renders in headless capture and the HTML body is empty).

8d4cc2c3ba0c4133924cb40c4836122c.description: Greenly is a carbon accounting and ESG platform for tracking and cutting business emissions. White ground, mint green accents and slate grey with a professional sans. Notable: oversized negative percentages used as the stats device to dramatise carbon reduction, and glassmorphism depth on the central product modal in the hero. A persistent cookie banner covers much of the page in headless render, so lower sections are partly visuals unverified.

dff73a4f2de94f818c71e48c3a54a411.description: The Greenrail Project (a Ng Foundation initiative) supports agricultural growers worldwide with training, accreditation, logistics and market access. Full-screen atmospheric hero: misty forest-to-golden-sky landscape photo under bold condensed all-caps white type, with a minimal logo-plus-hamburger header. Inner sections switch to editorial mode with large serif body text, generous whitespace and thin hairline dividers for a dignified, calm nonprofit tone.

26b6dd11456c4180905f987069a632bf.description: Obys Agency's educational project on grid systems, Awwwards Site of the Month for September 2021. It walks through modular, column, Van de Graaf and non-standard grids with practical tips and examples from agency projects. Light grey editorial layout, black type, a massive GRIDS headline, and the grid itself exposed as visual language. The real trick is interactive: a Grid toggle that reveals the underlying structure and a Crazy Mode that deliberately breaks it, turning the page into a live demo of its own subject. A books-and-credits page lists the sources.

3347b8e81d8880479954f34c2aee1b3c.description: Griflan is a Philadelphia creative agency doing branding, web design, development and motion for startups and scaling brands (TinyFish, Upshop, New Engen, Suzy Welch, ProSupps). The hero centres a huge high-contrast serif headline (Crafting brands that hit hard) on a deep charcoal ground, warmed by cream type, coral-red accents and small hand-drawn wave flourishes framing the subtext, with portfolio thumbnails peeking in from the bottom to bait the scroll. Notable blocks: a video-driven work grid tagged by sector, a You win. We grin. press wall that reframes case studies as client funding/exit headlines (raised $47M, acquired for $250M), a long recent-clients name list used as a typographic texture, and a Client Confessions testimonial section with hard conversion numbers (bounce rate down to 20-33%, conversions up to 6-7%). Strong reference for agency positioning that sells business outcomes rather than pretty pixels.

469550de2b8c41f3a398149c02209487.description: REDIRECTED — www.groove.ooo no longer serves the original site; it now lands on the Groove LinkedIn company profile behind a login interstitial (confirmed in two independent headless renders). The original product was Groove, a WFH coworking community app for founders, freelancers and creatives (many neurodivergent) built around “Grooves”: structured one-hour sessions with 1–3 others — 5 min on video to state intent, 50 min off video to focus, 5 min on video to report back. Mobile-only, $18/month or $120/year, founded by Josh Greene, Tova Safra and Sruli Rapps. The archived page was worth keeping for its member-card grid (each Groover with a photo, a Grooves count and a one-line human bio) and its checklist-style “Are you a Groover?” qualifier instead of a feature list. Current visual state is a LinkedIn profile, not the brand’s own design.

1d07b8e81d88802d8c28dd3c0e55e737.description: Grove AI sells "Grace", an AI Digital Staff agent that runs clinical-trial recruitment and participant engagement for sites, CROs and pharma sponsors (a top banner now announces the company was acquired by Hippocratic AI). Framer build. Split hero pairing an italic high-contrast serif headline with a right-side visual of chat/voice bubbles showing Grace talking to participants in several languages, so the product demonstrates itself instead of being described. Palette is deep forest green on white. Best blocks to steal: an oversized live-counter stats row (9.9M+ queries, 29,900+ appointments booked, 56,500+ hours saved), an outcome-metric case-study strip (580% more on-site screenings, 28% higher screening pass rate, 2-second response time), an integrations logo grid, and a testimonial carousel with real CRO executives. Useful reference for healthcare AI credibility design.

bcff4e12f62140e19f460a299a5f5930.description: GSAP (GreenSock Animation Platform) is the professional-grade JavaScript animation library, now free for everyone under Webflow's ownership. The hero is a dark charcoal canvas dominated by massive geometric sans type reading "Animate Anything", where the letters themselves scramble and animate and an exclamation mark is swapped in for the i in "anyth!ng", with small gradient 3D objects layered over and under the text to fake depth. A neon-green announcement bar caps the page for high contrast against the near-black, and secondary copy sits inside oversized curly braces. Strong inner pages: the Showcase, a video-tile grid of award-winning GSAP builds each tagged with the plugins used, and the tool landing pages for Scroll / SVG / Text / UI.

3177b8e81d8880d1b857e843d9870217.description: GTE (Global Token Exchange, by Liquid Labs) is a non-custodial onchain exchange where stocks, crypto and commodities trade from one account, powered by a high-throughput CLOB chain. Built in Framer. The hero pairs abstract motion-blurred coin photography with a high-contrast serif headline ("Trade fast. Win faster") on deep black with action-orange accents - a deliberately editorial, Wall-Street-adjacent look instead of the usual crypto-tech sans. Strong blocks: a bento feature grid with animated long/short order-book cards, an interactive A-B-C-D architecture diagram (Equities / AMM / CLOB / Aggregator) where each tab swaps the explanation, hard performance stats (100k orders/sec at 1ms latency), and a backers section listing funds, traders and angels as plain kinetic text rather than a logo wall. Graphic motifs (/// and >>>) carry the sense of speed.

8875b0f18f16498b96303f611da6b1ab.description: Gucci Osteria Florence is the Michelin-starred restaurant on Piazza della Signoria run with Massimo Bottura, with head chef Takahiko Kondo, plus the Gucci Giardino café and an e-shop. The hero pairs oversized high-contrast serif type — including graceful italics and a fine underline flourish under "Gucci" — with a centred architectural photograph the type overlaps, producing depth without any motion. Palette is taupe, cream and charcoal; the layout is symmetrical and print-derived, with prestige-level negative space doing most of the luxury signalling. Inner pages worth a look are the tasting menu and à la carte, which keep the same editorial serif system at smaller scale. Reference for hospitality and luxury brands where restraint is the whole design argument.

77ae95ce139d4407b5b309cc97a04f4a.description: "Guía de Cirugía Cardíaca" is a Spanish patient-education resource (website plus podcast) that walks cardiac-surgery patients and their families through the whole journey, pre-op, ICU, recovery, rehabilitation, risks and FAQs, in plain, reassuring language. Directed by Dr. Ángel G. Pinto (Hospital Gregorio Marañón) and team. The split informational hero uses a clinical-yet-empathetic palette of off-white, charcoal and mint green with a clean geometric sans, and its standout is a modular, card-based UI of flat, colorful healthcare illustrations plus "Historia Sonora" audio-guided content and a "where are you in the process?" selector. A great reference for warm, accessible healthcare UI and patient-friendly information design.

872e9958ada5476c8de08115d0ac7262.description: Halo Dental sells a consumer/professional dental hardware device (reserve-now pre-order model, bilingual EN/FR). The hero is a cinematic product shot: a sleek cylindrical device lit like studio jewellery, layered in front of an oversized "Halo" wordmark so the type reads as depth rather than decoration, on matte black with off-white type and one vivid orange CTA. Clean bold sans throughout. Worth stealing: the type-behind-product layering trick, the single saturated accent on an otherwise monochrome dark page, and the "Play the video" entry point next to the reserve CTA. Pricing and FAQ pages carry the conversion load.

6bafea0fb94e4ab4b1a6fb2768d5df5f.description: HAPE PRIME is a Web3/NFT brand of 8,192 fully-3D collectible ape avatars “built to unite the Ape multiverse,” styled by Digimental Studio (@DigimentalLDN) with a high-fashion streetwear aesthetic. The site is a WebGL experience that opens with a gritty film-grain, monochrome loader (circular progress with playful micro-copy like “Catching a bunch of HAPES”) before revealing the 3D content. A reference for texture-driven, high-anticipation loading states and premium 3D character branding. Note: the headless render stayed on the WebGL loader, so the main 3D hero is unverified and described from the brand's known 3D nature rather than a captured frame.

3169258aeb7848b091f92bda6a506309.description: Holiday greeting microsite by studio MadeInHaus. Single-scene 3D hero built on the inflatable/puffy aesthetic: bloated 3D letters, snowflakes and smileys floating and rotating out of sync on a cream background, in bubblegum pink, lavender, lime and soft yellow. The typographic contrast is the lesson here, chunky toy-like 3D forms set against a thin-stroke elegant serif and a bold wide serif headline. Good reference for a seasonal one-pager that carries a studio brand on motion and negative space alone rather than content volume.

16c7b8e81d8880d3b168c3e8995975be.description: Hatom is a DeFi liquidity hub on the MultiversX blockchain, offering lending and borrowing, liquid staking and the USH over-collateralized native stablecoin. Visuals unverified (loader/gate in headless render): the capture and a retry with a longer wait plus click both landed on the site's own intro preloader — a strictly monochrome black-on-white screen with a centered geometric egg/orb line-mark, a "LOADING 5 PHASES" counter and a "headphones recommended" note. That preloader is itself the steal-worthy artifact: it sets expectations by naming how many phases are coming and asking for audio before the experience starts. The markup confirms a heavily art-directed, audio-accompanied multi-phase WebGL/video intro and a thin multilingual marketing site (Home, About, Contact) with the real product living at app.hatom.com. Hero type left unset because the composition was never actually rendered.

1ddfd8cfcb3a40ac9cd7e8662a7c7b05.description: Hazelight Studios is the Stockholm co-op game developer behind A Way Out, It Takes Two and Split Fiction. The site is an editorial dark-mode build: charcoal ground, cream-white type, and a massive bold sans headline physically sandwiched between overlapping photographs so the words sit inside the image stack rather than on top of it. Monospaced labels handle sidebar text, captions and the "Join us" CTA, and vertical side-aligned type deliberately breaks the standard grid. Mixed image aspect ratios build cinematic depth in an otherwise static layout. Games, studio culture and jobs pages continue the same asymmetric collage system. Excellent reference for type-and-photo layering without any 3D or motion budget.

2cd7b8e81d888047adcbce553e291f4b.description: Headroom positions itself as "the small business operating system for AI", a workflow and AI platform for running a small business. The site is a client-rendered Next.js SPA, so it returns no server-side body and did not paint in a headless render. Visuals unverified (loader/blank in headless render), so no hero, palette or block claims are recorded here beyond the positioning. Worth a manual revisit if it comes up as a reference.

16d7b8e81d88809ebe4dd26eee45588a.description: HEAVN One is a German €1,290 desk luminaire that combines desk lamp, ceiling uplight and a 10,000-lux daylight lamp, developed with sleep researchers. Webflow landing page by Double Play studio. The hero is a chiaroscuro product-in-use photograph where the lamp itself is the only light source in the frame, so the product demonstrates its own function, with an oversized "One" as the typographic anchor and a letter-by-letter H-E-A-V-N reveal. The standout block is a scroll-driven day timeline: an animated odometer clock counts from 08:00 through the evening while the copy and imagery change to match each lighting mode, turning a spec list into a narrative. Also has a testimonial from investor Frank Thelen, deep spec accordions and a 30-day risk-free CTA. Great reference for single-product hardware pages.

5b0f482a949048ec84ecf1fa6a1bdc3c.description: Heights is a strategic and creative growth consultancy. Deep teal ground with crisp white type, and a bold vertically condensed sans that fills the screen. The standout technique is the numerical preloader: individual digits scroll vertically and hand off seamlessly into the "Heights" brand headline, setting a precise, technical tone before any content loads. Only the opening screens rendered in headless capture, so sections below the hero are visuals unverified.

fee4c34e89674bf1b36e063f38f2dc17.description: Landing page from Cuberto, the design agency known for heavy custom motion and cursor work. The loader itself is the memorable part and the only thing verifiable here: bold all-caps lime green type on black stating "WE CREATE MEMORABLE WEBSITES", with a 0-100% counter and a blinking underscore cursor that terminates the sentence like a terminal prompt. The experience never advances past the loader across two capture attempts, so visuals unverified (loader/gate in headless render) for the body of the page.

16c7b8e81d8880058ec9c95859272ea5.description: Aria is a French/EU fintech selling an embedded invoice-financing and B2B payments API: marketplaces, SaaS platforms, ERPs and card issuers plug it in so suppliers get paid within 24h while buyers keep 30/60/90-day terms, with Aria carrying the credit risk. The visual system is a deep midnight-teal canvas with a vibrant mint/cyan accent that glows on the CTA, plus a lavender-pink gradient tail in the illustrations; the geometric sans headline flips into a stylised italic on the value phrase, a cheap and very effective emphasis trick. Instead of stock photography it runs abstract dot-grid and line illustrations on a paper-plane motif. Notable blocks: a tabbed segment switcher (Marketplaces / SaaS / Cards / Corporates), a four-step infrastructure walkthrough, a Malt customer story and a conversational FAQ. Desktop hero partly inferred from the mobile render.

2497b8e81d888042993eeb21365ed29f.description: Bonsai is an all-in-one business management SaaS (CRM, projects, invoicing, time tracking, contracts) for freelancers and service agencies, 500k+ users. Conversion-first hero: heavy modern sans headline centered on clean white with dual high-contrast CTAs and a 5-star "1,020+ reviews" social-proof strip. The standout device is a horizontal icon tab bar under the fold — around 19 product modules (CRM, Pipeline, Estimates, Timesheets, Rate cards), each swapping in its own product UI screenshot, communicating platform breadth without clutter. Deep programmatic inner pages segmented by industry plus a large template and calculator resource library. Built on Webflow.

8a63f71488be4f6b893a194e3a391236.description: VOUM is a social fitness app for tracking workouts, visualising progress and connecting with a gym community. Light grey ground with purple and lime accents, soft floating organic shapes for depth, and a geometric sans. The hero trick worth stealing: coloured pill-shaped highlights sitting behind individual words in the headline to spotlight the "social gym" positioning without extra copy. Only the upper sections rendered in headless capture, so lower blocks are visuals unverified.

62e40b9989184de68848f36aef5444b6.description: Hematogenix (“Bringing Precision Medicine to Everyone”) is a specialty reference laboratory and specialised CRO for oncology — flow cytometry, molecular genetics, NGS, histology/IHC, cytogenetics/FISH, pathology and digital pathology and image analysis. It serves pharma, biotech, diagnostic developers and oncologists, supporting novel drug launches and companion-diagnostic validation. CAP and CLIA certified and GCP-compliant, HQ in Chicago with labs in Manchester (UK), Shanghai and Cyberjaya (Malaysia), including the first central laboratory in clinical research in Malaysia as an Asia-Pacific hub. Useful as a healthcare/biotech reference with strong inner pages for Company, Services, Clinical Trials processes and a press-release resource hub. Visuals unverified (Vercel bot-verification checkpoint blocks the headless render).

af3789e4f8ff4866b70d27e123b4a896.description: Henri Heymans is a designer/developer portfolio (existing tags point to a dark, 3D, big-type build with horizontal scrolling). The page rendered only as a dark loading state in headless capture, so visuals are unverified (loader/WebGL-heavy portfolio in headless render). The domain resolves; only the render could not be captured.

a20f045b9b924628929cdb0afb6f841c.description: Heva Health is a modern functional-medicine membership: at-home testing, treatment and ongoing care ("Vitality, refined"). The hero uses layered, double-exposure-style photography for an ethereal, calm feel, an italic serif headline against modern sans nav, and an earthy palette of greens, warm beige and deep olive. Conversion craft worth noting: a pill-shaped floating nav, a clear primary/secondary CTA pair ("Explore Treatment Programs" vs "Take our 2-Min Wellness Quiz") and an "HSA/FSA eligible" trust badge above the fold. Solid reference for premium healthcare UI that avoids clinical blue, plus quiz-as-lead-magnet placement.

4b0a503b07d94aacb6874ddbad804b95.description: Heyday Studio is a French creative studio in Toulouse and Paris doing branding and interior design for places (Le Local, West Store, a hot sauce brand). Monochrome editorial homepage: massive sans wordmark, generous whitespace, and a services line mixing clean sans with light italic serif for rhythm. The project index shows a counter (17 Projets) and centers bold titles above full-width imagery, with descriptions set in quiet grey.

22c7b8e81d8880499428f67a78cbfdcc.description: Orbi is an AI agent that scrapes the web for freelance leads and drops them into a daily scored feed. Dark-mode showpiece hero: a near-black canvas framed by a vivid neon mesh-gradient aura (cyan, magenta and orange bleeding in from the edges), a heavy modern sans headline, and a glassmorphic dashboard card underneath showing live lead cards with match-percentage scores (93%, 88%, 96%) and source icons (Reddit, Twitter, AngelList). Hand-drawn annotation scribbles ("Orbi makes finding leads this easy") add a human counterpoint to the high-tech look. Below: a looping monochrome logo marquee, a three-card problem block, and a numbered 1-2-3 process section with connecting hand-drawn arrows. Pre-launch beta, Webflow build. Site by Two Hands (twohands.studio).

2147b8e81d88808b9ccadc965a636ea1.description: HIFI (HiFi Bridge) is a NYC stablecoin and payments-infrastructure company — a composable API for identity, custody, routing and settlement across fiat and stablecoin rails (25+ currencies, 170+ local payment methods). The homepage is a hard developer-infra aesthetic: void-black background, stark white type and a single electric lime-chartreuse accent, with a massive bold geometric grotesque headline pushed into the bottom-left corner — an asymmetric, negative-space-heavy composition with no product imagery at all. The lime works as hierarchical colour-coding, tinting the key word in the headline and the BOOK DEMO button so the value prop and the CTA read as one visual unit. Worth stealing for fintech/crypto infra: solidity communicated purely through type weight and void. JS-rendered, so the block inventory is limited.

3a37b8e81d8880a39768cc72a15fff1e.description: Hilden & Kaira is a Finnish organic-social content agency (Finlayson, Kierratyskeskus, Autoliitto, Pekka Haavisto's presidential campaign) promising to 10x your social presence or work for free. The hero is deliberately confrontational big type — "If you can't reach a million people with 0 EUR ad spend, your branding sucks" — in a sharp high-contrast serif on stark white and black with lime-green accents and a liquid-chrome Y2K 3D wordmark assembled letter-by-letter from individual AVIF glyphs. Tilted overlapping photo thumbnails break the grid into a collage. The case blocks are the standout: autoplaying vertical TikTok-style video cards with live view/like counters and a 30-day organic-views stats readout. Webflow, design by Dylan Brouwer.

16c7b8e81d8880b689feed39b4e00f7e.description: Hims is the men's side of Hims & Hers: online telehealth for weight loss (GLP-1s), sexual health, hair loss, testosterone, mental health and lab testing, all asynchronous and delivered discreetly. Same design system as Hers but in a warmer cream, sand and orange grade: a modular card-grid hero where each service line gets its own tile, product packaging shot directly inside the CTA card, bold serif headlines against a clean functional sans. Best blocks: the GLP-1 lineup rail with FDA-approved badges and pricing, a testosterone module with an at-home lab upsell, the 130+ biomarker scrolling visualiser plus a 50+ cancer-signal screening card, and a credentialed medical-advisor block with named specialists. Note how footnotes and legal disclaimers are folded into collapsible "Read more" blocks so compliance never breaks the layout.

22c7b8e81d8880128631f0dd82735b6a.description: Chore (by Levy, Inc.) is a fractional chief-of-staff and back-office service — dedicated humans plus an AI ops copilot ("Ollie") running HR, payroll, bookkeeping, compliance and equity for startups. Split hero: left-aligned copy and a lead-capture form over a full-bleed painterly mid-century-modern digital illustration with soft atmospheric lighting; deep forest green, warm cream and earthy ochre, with a tall elegant serif headline against a functional sans for UI. Notable blocks: an investor logo marquee (YC, Techstars, Khosla, Bessemer, Bain), a four-card service bento (HR / Compliance / Finance / Equity) using rendered 3D-object illustrations, a four-step process with clay-style icons, and a genuinely good comparison table (Internal Hire vs Fractional CFO vs Software Only vs Chore, with cost, time and team-size rows). Warm, illustrated, non-tech B2B aesthetic — a strong reference for "human service brand, not SaaS".

2147b8e81d8880f482aef453ad5a108e.description: Our Roots / Flashlights is the interactive historical archive of the Jailhouse Lawyer Initiative (Jhody Polk with NYU Law's Bernstein Institute), documenting incarcerated people who teach themselves law to advocate for their peers. Visually it is editorial-brutalist: a muted cream ground with watermelon-red colour-blocked chapters, thick black rules framing sections, and a massive ultra-bold condensed sans headline set against small framed archival images — an extreme scale contrast that reads like a printed broadsheet. The core block is a four-chapter scrubbing timeline (1700s to present) with year-pin navigation, collapsible fact cards, cut-out collage GIFs and hand-drawn animated artwork; the page opens with a content-warning / ethics-of-care overlay. Excellent reference for archival scrollytelling and non-profit storytelling. Webflow build.

4cf1c5a044a14e22b20bdffe0fd010de.description: Hoboken Yogi is a New Jersey yoga teacher and retreat leader (Jill, 200 RYT) running classes plus curated retreats to Spain, Peru, Iceland and the Catskills. The hero layers oversized high-contrast serif type over a portrait photograph of the instructor on a warm textured off-white ground, with dark slate-blue text, a gold logo and a delicate geometric line-art accent. Reference for warm, editorial big-type-over-portrait wellness branding.

0dbb83a6b48d4642a9858cd8bf8271bb.description: Hotel Gilbert is a Vienna hotel with an editorial, sustainability-forward site. A photo hero of lush greenery carries a bold slab-serif headline ('Truly your hotel') alongside monospaced typewriter-style UI, and a dark circular 'Green Hotel' badge breaks the rectangular grid to draw focus. The monospaced type used even for technical and privacy information gives the whole thing a modern, trustworthy editorial feel.

eb754663dd484b8c8e792cf2b4aaf7b4.description: Promotional experience for Ridley Scott's House of Gucci film, built in native WebGL — site by Aristide Benoist with Index Studio and WatsonDG. It was nominated for Site of the Year and Developer of the Year at the Awwwards, and is one of the reference points for full-WebGL film promo storytelling. Visuals unverified (the WebGL scene never renders in a headless capture — the page stays blank through the loader), so hero type and blocks are left unset rather than invented. Worth opening in a real browser to study the scroll-driven scene transitions.

c7acdd22ff324f14974cde5f8541d31f.description: Houseplant is Seth Rogen and Evan Goldberg’s design-led home-goods and cannabis-lifestyle brand (Shopify) — ceramics, ashtrays, planters, rugs, furniture, vinyl and rolling papers, plus collabs with Carbone Fine Food, KITH, OCB, Cometeer and Airbnb. The interesting move is category subversion: it merchandises smoking accessories as collectible interiors objects (Gloopy Ashtray $95, Gloopy Vase $145, Standing Ashtray $295), so the site reads like a design store, not a dispensary. Entry is behind a hard “Are you over 21?” age gate; past it a promotional interstitial uses split-screen lifestyle staging — dark espresso ground against a warm maximalist Mediterranean dining scene with products embedded in the set rather than shot on white. Notable blocks: a hero carousel, a New & Featured product grid, a collab feature block and a founders story section. Visuals partly unverified — the age gate and promo modal block a clean headless render of the true hero.

61eeecc10a4b432e9c55540acb576c90.description: Marketplace for fractional design teams paid in cash plus equity. Hero: giant headline with circular avatars and role chips embedded directly inside the H1, muted off-white with dusty rose, ochre and sage accents; live feed cards of active huddles with status labels (ACTIVE, SHIPPED, TEAM FORMING). Below: 4-step process with founder quotes, dual-audience split (I'm a Company / I'm a Designer), activity ticker. Strong ref for community products and inline-avatar typographic heroes.

2497b8e81d888003b4dddcf491e3a754.description: Huly is an open-source all-in-one team workspace (project management, chat, docs, virtual office, calendar) positioned as a Linear/Jira/Slack/Notion replacement. Dark-mode hero with left-aligned copy against a dramatic central vertical light beam, deep navy-charcoal with white text and high-energy amber glows, a heavy geometric sans headline with tight tracking over a light body font. Techniques worth stealing: the vertical light-streak focal column doing the work of a product image, a CTA that glows from the inside, and a subtle noise/stipple grain over the dark gradient that keeps it from feeling flat. Product UI showcase and bento grid sections carry the feature story. Case study published by Pixel Point.

ff32eef471964afcb2a8dd81b76eac07.description: Humaan is an award-winning Australian digital agency (Perth, Sydney, Melbourne, Los Angeles) building websites, apps and digital products, most awarded studio at the Australian Web Awards. The hero is confident and minimal: creamy off-white on deep forest green, one massive tight-kerned sans headline ('Extraordinary Digital Experiences'), a centred floating pill nav that reads more like software than a website header, and a small lime accent mark. Notable blocks: an animated counter stats trio (100% in-house, years crafting, 60+ awards), a featured-work showcase (PIQUE, Sussex Taps, Chaleit, Exposing Surveillance), a reverse-chronological 'What's New' timeline mixing award wins, launches and Christmas cards, and a rotating-word CTA. Good reference for studio positioning pages.

2cd7b8e81d8880a0aaefda452eab9499.description: Humble (humbleops.ai now resolves to humbleops.com) is an AI platform that auto-generates custom real-time operational software, a "Factory OS", for manufacturing floors in 24 hours, sitting alongside existing ERP/MES rather than replacing them. Framer build with a big-type hero backed by autoplay product clips and factory photography. The standout block is a 9-row comparison matrix pitting Humble against Big Box MES/ERP, DIY low-code and doing nothing, plus a role-tabbed features section (Shop Floor / Planners / Quality / Ops / Exec) where each tab swaps in its own video, and a Day 1 to Year 1 build-sprint timeline. Visuals unverified (capture queue stalled in headless render), so hero type left unset.

3330a5e4d3344dc9b1d4bd797d4811a5.description: Humbleteam is a Prague-based digital product design agency (UX/UI, web, branding) working with startups and enterprises — 20+ Y Combinator companies, NASA, Deloitte, Royal Caribbean. The hero runs a full-bleed photo drenched in a cinematic red-orange colour wash, with a massive tight-tracked white sans headline over it and a translucent blurred glassmorphism nav floating on top; award badges sit low in the frame as quiet social proof. Below, the site leans on case-study cards, credibility numbers (100+ products shipped, $500M+ raised by clients) and a client logos bar. Good reference for agency sites that need to feel premium and high-energy at the same time rather than sterile-minimal.

de9e93fa6b494bed8bf9319f2b099858.description: Huntflow is a Russian recruitment automation system (ATS) that uses AI to speed up hiring pipelines and close vacancies faster. White and light grey base with vibrant neon green primary buttons, and soft pink/purple gradients reserved specifically for AI features, which is a clean way to colour-code a new capability inside an existing brand. Floating glassmorphic product cards, layered shadows for depth, and scroll-triggered UI animation. Stats block leans on recruiter and client counts; the features block uses tabbed navigation to split automation from client work.

2887b8e81d88803ebf76e100e8e43f14.description: HUTS is a US design-and-build service for rural homes, selling pre-engineered house "Standards" (ADU, Small Bar, Dogtrot, Village) alongside land sourcing and build coordination. Typography-driven full-bleed hero over a looping background video: deep forest and olive greens, off-white text, a pale lime CTA, and a high-contrast elegant serif headline set against a heavy blocky sans logotype. A hand-drawn sketchy underline on the headline injects an architectural-sketch, human touch into an otherwise calm monochromatic earthy palette. The best block to steal is the Standards gallery: a product grid of axonometric renders with bed/bath and square-footage specs revealed on hover, which turns houses into browsable SKUs.

c91cd7c03bff472aa36068847f9e951c.description: Portfolio of Huy Phan, an independent website and interaction designer based in Ho Chi Minh City. The homepage is a single-viewport index rather than a scrolling page: a name-as-hero built from a typographic mashup that sets a high-contrast calligraphic serif for 'Huy' against a clean geometric sans for 'Phan', in black on off-white. Navigation is a numbered list (01 Works, 02 About, 03 Playground, 04 Contact) and metadata is pushed into the corners, mimicking editorial print layout. A small line-art self-illustration breaks the rigid type. Worth stealing for the serif/sans identity mashup and the corner-anchored editorial grid.

2487b8e81d888039830ded658ad89717.description: Hyperbolic is an open-access GPU and AI cloud (on-demand H100 / H200 / B200, reserved clusters, private cloud, OpenAI-compatible inference API) used by 250K+ builders. The hero is a mixed-weight big-type headline ("the Open-Access AI Cloud") with two CTAs, sitting above an unusually heavy multi-row logo marquee — four stacked scrolling rows of customers and partners (Midjourney, Hugging Face, Qwen, CMU, Yale, HeyGen). Further down: a three-way plan chooser (On-Demand / Reserved / Private Cloud), a dark product video of the GPU rental dashboard with a playful "Buckle up! We're deploying your GPUs…" deploy state, an icon-illustrated stats block (250K+ engineers, Minutes Not Weeks, Zero Quota Limit, No Long-Term Lock-In), a Hugging Face CEO testimonial and a clean FAQ. Visuals unverified (loader/gate in headless render) — the site throws a client-side exception in headless Chromium, so description is HTML-derived.

c059216d5e014445abce26aab843fb4c.description: Hyperframe makes a no-screw, snap-together metal wall-framing system for commercial construction (BIM-modeled kits, AR-guided install, up to 15x faster than traditional steel framing). The hero is a dark-mode product shot of high-contrast 3D-rendered steel components under dramatic low-key lighting, with deep blacks, clean white sans type and a vibrant lime-green circular CTA and scroll cue. Reference for precision-engineered, dark industrial product-tech branding.

20d400b617974dae975e496196ff8a38.description: Dedicated product microsite for the Polaroid I-2 instant camera. Strict dark-mode aesthetic: deep black backgrounds, oversized white sans headlines and a single yellow accent reserved for the Buy button and nav highlights, giving a premium feel appropriate to high-end photo hardware. Sticky top nav keeps tech specs, compare and the CTA reachable throughout. The strongest idea is how it interleaves close-up hardware shots (rear manual controls, display) with the actual instant photos the camera produces, so the modes showcase demonstrates value instead of just listing features. Deeper sections partly obscured by cookie and region-confirmation modals in headless render.

b0a999d3092240f4be1f7aaa05665ac2.description: ICAM-INOX is an Italian manufacturer of stainless steel equipment and furnishings for hypermarkets, hospitals, the food industry and custom design runs (Soliera, Modena). The domain now serves the same company's site on icaminox.it. Hero is a cool slate-blue field filled with high-fidelity isometric renders of steel cabinets, counters and refrigerated units, overlaid with a massive tight-kerned bold sans headline. The standout technique is typographic depth layering: products overlap individual letters so the type sits inside the 3D space, while the background tone is matched to the steel itself for a monochromatic, catalog-pure look. Navigation is stripped to logo, EN/IT toggle and a hamburger, letting the renders carry the brand.

3437b8e81d88805eab69ea03fed23664.description: ICOMAT (Engineer Without Limits) is a UK deep-tech manufacturer that invented Rapid Tow Shearing (RTS), a patented process that steers carbon-fibre tows along curved load paths instead of straight lines, for aerospace, defence, space and automotive parts. The homepage is a dark, cinematic scrolltelling narrative built around a background hero video and side-by-side comparison videos of conventional vs steered fibre composites. Standout blocks: a scroll-driven Before RTS / RTS Design / At scale / Zero defects / 10x faster chapter sequence, hard performance stats (up to 65% lighter, 10x faster production), an O1-O7 end-to-end production process strip, an others vs The Icomat Way comparison list, and named testimonials from Joby Aviation, BAE Systems, NIAR and Pall Aerospace. Site by rejouice. Note: the automated screenshot only captured the intro preloader, so the visual frame is blank; visual notes here are based on the live HTML and video assets.

3687b8e81d8880f7acb0dbd4407c46d7.description: Idyllic is a self-described "disruptive design studio" in New Plymouth, NZ (branding, web, marketing, video). Loud, humor-first branding: the capture shows their intentional entry popup — a mock "WARNING!" modal with skull, striped pink/orange maximalist background, checkerboard border and a "I WANT MY MUMMY" escape button. Behind it the hero is a video loop with giant "DARE TO DISRUPT" SVG type and a services marquee; further down sit a self-deprecating "things we're not great at" ticker, hover-swap object illustrations, chunky testimonials and an "Idyllic Antics" press/stunt gallery. Great reference for personality-driven agency copywriting.

54a0560fbf304e508b5065829b003a2f.description: Inflection is a venture capital firm backing "engineering moonshots" and deeply technical founders. The site runs a high-contrast monochrome, brutalist-leaning grid where the only colour comes from portfolio video thumbnails: cinematic footage of supersonic aircraft and microscopic cells playing inside an otherwise stark black-and-white layout. Split hero, hover-revealed metadata on portfolio items, and a video-driven gallery instead of a conventional case-study list. Good reference for a VC or deep-tech firm that wants restraint plus cinematic proof.

2cd7b8e81d888033b2dce8160dd8315c.description: INK Games (Austin, TX) is a web3 gaming company connecting play and rewards: its hit title Prize Kingdoms pays real cash prizes, and the ecosystem includes INK ID and INKPay, a peer-to-peer payment app that turns social connections into earnings. The homepage opens with an unusually aggressive typographic hero - stark white ultra-bold condensed all-caps on pure black, set with minimal leading so the headline becomes a wall of type filling the viewport, with no imagery at all. It is a confident "the message is the visual" move, and the sheer scale plus negative space does the work that a 3D render usually would. The rest of the site leans on motion and 3D game assets. Good reference for maximal-type heroes and for gaming/web3 brands that want to feel like a statement rather than a storefront.

2147b8e81d8880f885ddf3db917350dd.description: inne is a Berlin femtech brand selling the inne Minilab — a CE/IVDR-certified saliva-based hormone tracker used for hormone-free contraception and fertility monitoring. Shopify build with a warm organic wellness palette of terracotta, soft peach, cream and deep forest green, pairing a clean sans UI with a refined high-contrast serif headline to blend clinical authority with elegance. Steal-worthy: the floating pill-shaped nav bar and an unusual inline efficacy block that bar-charts inne (92%) against condom, pill and IUD with hormone-free flags. Also strong: a deep pricing/plan configurator with cost breakdowns, a competitor feature comparison matrix (vs thermometers, fertility apps, ovulation kits), an eligibility checklist section and Trustpilot/App Store rating stats.

086489881149465ab491655f4da18d39.description: Innovation microsite for Varex Imaging, an independent supplier of medical X-ray tubes and imaging components for medical, cargo screening and border security. It is a single-page editorial build with no inner pages: numbered blocks (01B / Latest, 03 / Vision, 04 / Investors) carry the story, closing on a 'Get in touch' CTA. Visuals unverified — the page throws a Next.js client-side exception in a headless render and only the logo and error state paint, so hero type is left unset.

4ef2057ed4814c4dbfe7f2d4820ee31f.description: Intercom sells a customer-service helpdesk built around its Fin AI Agent. The hero uses a split-text layout — a massive left-aligned headline against a smaller right-aligned copy and CTA block — set in bold modern sans paired with a traditional serif for body, on off-white with black text and small blue accents. Its signature technique is the horizontal mood-board photo reel of unrelated emotive imagery (kites, balloons, ink flowers) anchoring the bottom of the hero and repeating in the footer, humanising a technical product. Below: a 30,000+ brands logo bar, a tabbed product showcase, feature accordions, named customer quotes and a transparent per-seat plus per-outcome pricing block.

01d7af22caec47178cd3da1c6ea289c8.description: Interface In Game is a reference library of video-game UI — thousands of screenshots and clips from 1,000+ titles, browsable by genre, theme and interface element (menu, inventory, HUD, skill tree, scoreboard). The homepage hero is a silent looping gameplay video of a featured title behind flat dark UI with visible hairline borders. Its real value is the navigation architecture: several stacked carousels and grids, each a different taxonomy axis (genres with game counts, recent additions, UI elements with screenshot counts, themes), so the same library is entered from many angles. Also runs interviews with game UX/UI leads and sells a wireframe mockup pack. Best-in-class model for a large visual archive that has to stay browsable.

74904ff962a047c9960467a59bcd0245.description: Intrepid Automation builds high-speed industrial 3D printing / additive manufacturing systems. The site opens on a stark black-and-white hero: a single bold sans-serif question ("Are you ready for perfectly made parts?") centred in heavy negative space, framed by thin corner brackets that read like a viewfinder or engineering blueprint, with monospaced labels (A01 / A02 / A03, SCROLL DOWN) doing the navigation. Worth stealing: the bracket-framing device and the mono + grotesque pairing to signal industrial precision without any decoration; the numbered section indexing gives the scrolltelling a machine-log feel.

cf2d0e92b275477e8d0114c170e7fe1a.description: The DJ and the War Crimes is Rolling Stone's Emmy-nominated interactive investigation retracing a Bosnian war crime, with an evidence archive authenticated with Starling Lab. Hero sets gigantic distressed ultra-condensed type that bleeds off the canvas, framing a collage of grainy war photography, documents and leaked-metadata hex strings in red, white and charcoal. Monospace typewriter and handwritten accents plus film grain give a raw forensic-dossier feel. Includes an interactive evidence library (photos, video, documents). Won a National Magazine Award for digital design.

ee324c840ab24a8b96b22e3191838961.description: Chantlings is a singing app for iPhone/iPad (also Android) by studio IORAMA in collaboration with Heart of Noise — a touch-free music toy where you control Moomin-like forest characters purely with your voice: they read tonality and improvise harmonies, react to pronounced words and vocal rhythm, each with a distinctive voice. An Apple Design Award finalist in 2023; all animation runs in real time in Unity wired to harmony and audio engines. The hero is a split-screen: deep black atmospheric background, a high-fidelity phone mockup on the right, and forest green / warm orange / cyan pops emerging only from the characters inside the screen, with a soft ethereal glow and organic silhouettes for depth. The title uses a custom whimsical serif with stylised diacritics. Notable blocks: looping Vimeo video sections per feature (Harmonious / Lyrical / Connected), a phone-frame product showcase, and an SVG architecture diagram of the audio pipeline. Site by IORAMA.

3177b8e81d8880ae89bde09f2bbf4df4.description: Iru is the rebrand of Kandji, now an AI-native IT and security platform unifying endpoint management, workforce identity and compliance automation across Apple, Windows and Android. The hero pairs a bold tight-tracked neo-grotesque headline (Run IT and security from one platform) with layered isometric 3D product cards connected by glowing paths, set on a clean off-white ground with pink, cyan and orange gradient accents and deep-navy CTAs; a 700+ 5-star reviews badge sits above the H1 and a product announcement bar rides on top. Notable blocks: a scrolling customer logo marquee (Airbus, Vercel, Cursor, Plaid, Bumble, McLaren), three anchored product sections each with a full-bleed dashboard screenshot, a Point and click or commit and push section contrasting the visual builder against config-as-code, a Numbers don't lie stats row (50 hours saved/month, 6,000+ teams, 2.3x zero-days stopped, 4.75/5 from 700+ G2 reviews) with footnoted sources, and photo-backed customer quotes. Strong reference for platform consolidation messaging and isometric product illustration.
